title: Lindsay Clancy suffering 'command hallucination' when she killed children, court hears
english: During the trial of Lindsay Clancy, who is accused of killing her three children, a forensic psychiatrist testified that she was experiencing severe postpartum psychosis at the time. The defense argues she suffered from command hallucinations and delusions, making her unable to understand the wrongfulness of her actions. While prosecutors claim the killings were calculated, the defense maintains she was experiencing a mental health crisis that prevented her from controlling her behavior.
amharic: ሶስት ልጆቿን በመግደል የተከሰሰችው ሊንዚ ክላንሲ በችሎት ላይ በነበረችበት ወቅት ከባድ የወሊድ ድባቴ (postpartum psychosis) እንደነበረባት የፎረንሲክ ሳይካትሪስት አስረድተዋል። መከላከያዋ ክላንሲ ድርጊቱን የፈጸመችው የውስጥ ድምፆች በሚያዙት ትዕዛዝ መሰረት መሆኑን እና በወቅቱ የራሷን ድርጊት መቆጣጠር እንደማትችል ተናግረዋል። አቃቤ ህግ ግድያው የታቀደ መሆኑን ቢከራከርም፣ መከላከያ በኩል ግን የአእምሮ ህመሟ የመወሰን አቅሟን እንደነፈጋት በማስረጃ አስደግፈዋል።
oromo: Mucoolii ishee sadan ajjeeste jedhamtee kan himatamte Lindsay Clancy, yeroo yakka sana raawwattetti dhukkuba sammuu cimaa kan daa'ima deessuu booda dhufuun miidhamtee akka turte ogeessi sammuu ragaa ba'eera. Manni murtii himannoo ishee irratti xiyyeeffachaa jiru yeroo ammaa kana, himatamtuun sammuun ishee guutummaatti too'annoo ishee ala ta'ee turuu isaa ragaaleen dhihaatan agarsiisu. Abbaan alangaa tarkaanfichi kan karoorfame ture jedhee himatus, gartuun ishee immoo rakkoo fayyaa sammuu isheetiin kan ka'e murtoo sirrii gochuu akka hin dandeenye falmataa jira.

title: China’s new moon mission could unlock secret of lunar ice: Why that matters
english: China is preparing to launch the Chang’e-7 mission, a robotic space project aimed at discovering ice water located in the permanently shadowed craters of the moon's south pole. This mission is highly significant because finding accessible lunar water could provide essential resources for future human crews. Furthermore, studying this ice may reveal critical scientific information about the history of the moon and the origins of water in our solar system.
amharic: ቻይና የቻንግ-ኢ-7 የተሰኘ የጠፈር ምርምር ተልዕኮ ወደ ጨረቃ ደቡብ ዋልታ ለመላክ ዝግጅቷን አጠናቃለች። የዚህ ተልዕኮ ዋና ዓላማ ጨረቃ ላይ በሚገኙ ጥቁር እና ለፀሐይ ብርሃን በማይደርሱባቸው ጉድጓዶች ውስጥ ያለውን በረዶ መመርመር ነው። በጨረቃ ላይ ውሃ መኖሩን ማረጋገጥ ለወደፊት የሰው ልጅ የጠፈር ጉዞዎች መጠጥና ነዳጅ ለማግኘት ትልቅ ፋይዳ አለው። በተጨማሪም ይህ በረዶ ስለ ጨረቃ አመጣጥ እና ስለ ስርዓተ ፀሐይ ታሪክ ጠቃሚ የሳይንስ መረጃዎችን ይዞ ሊሆን እንደሚችል ይታመናል።
oromo: Chaayinaan ergama haaraa 'Chang'e-7' jedhamu kan roobootii of keessaa qabu gara ji'aatti erguuf qophiirra jirti. Kaayyoon ergama kanaa laga ji'aa keessatti lafa ifni hin geenye fi gaaddisa keessa jiran keessatti bishaan ykn cabbii barbaaduu dha. Bishaan ji'aarratti argamu kun gara fuulduraatti namoota gara ji'aatti imalanif bishaan dhugaatii fi qabeenya barbaachisaa ta'uu danda'a. Kana malees, qorannoon kun waa'ee seenaa ji'aatii fi akkaataa bishaan sirna aduu keessatti uumame hubachuuf gargaara.

title: ‘It was a tsunami’: Floods leave death trail in India’s Assam
english: Severe monsoon flooding in India’s Assam state has caused catastrophic damage after heavy rains triggered river surges and landslides. The disaster has claimed over 100 lives, destroyed thousands of homes, and displaced hundreds of thousands of people. Many families, such as that of Debiram Panika, are left grieving as they search for missing loved ones amidst the ruins of their villages.
amharic: በሕንድ አሳም ግዛት የጣለው ከባድ የዝናብ መጠን በፈጠረው ድንገተኛ ጎርፍ እና የመሬት መንሸራተት ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሷል። በአደጋው ከ100 በላይ ሰዎች ሕይወታቸውን ያጡ ሲሆን፣ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ቤቶች በመውደማቸው እና በመቶ ሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች በመፈናቀላቸው ሰብአዊ ቀውስ ተፈጥሯል። እንደ ዴቢራም ፓኒካ ያሉ ተጎጂዎች በጎርፍ የጠፉ የቤተሰባቸውን አባላት ፍለጋ ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Mootummaa Hindii keessatti naannoo Asaamitti rooba cimaa robeen hordofee lolaan garmalee ka’e miidhaa guddaa geessiseera. Balaa kanaan lubbuun namoota 100 ol darbeera, manneen kumaan lakkaawwaman barbadaa’anii, namoonni dhibbaan lakkaawwaman immoo qe’ee isaanii irraa buqqa’aniiru. Namoonni akka Debiram Panikaa jiran maatiin isaanii balaa kanaan waan jalaa badaniif gadda hamaa keessa jiru.

title: Canada says it will match US tariffs 'dollar for dollar' as trade talks break down
english: Canada has announced plans to implement equal retaliatory tariffs on American goods following the collapse of recent trade negotiations. Prime Minister Mark Carney decided to suspend talks after claiming the U.S. introduced unfair last-minute changes to the proposed agreement. Consequently, new U.S. levies on Canadian products have now taken effect, marking a significant escalation in tensions between the two nations.
amharic: የካናዳ እና የአሜሪካ የንግድ ድርድር በመቋረጡ ምክንያት ካናዳ በአሜሪካ ምርቶች ላይ ተመሳሳይ የሆነ የታሪፍ እርምጃ ለመውሰድ ወሰነች። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ማርክ ካርኒ በአሜሪካ የቀረቡት የመጨረሻ ደቂቃ ለውጦች ተቀባይነት የሌላቸው በመሆናቸው ድርድሩን ማቋረጣቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ ተከትሎ አሜሪካ በካናዳ ምርቶች ላይ የጣለችው አዲስ የታሪፍ ቀረጥ በይፋ ተግባራዊ ሆኗል።
oromo: Hirmaannaan daldalaa Ameerikaa fi Kaanaadaa gidduutti gaggeeffamaa ture erga gufatee booda, Kaanaadaan gabaa Ameerikaa irraa dhufullee irratti gatii gibiraa wal-qixa ta'e kaa'uuf murteessiteetti. Muummichi ministeeraa Maark Kaarnii akka jedhanitti, Ameerikaan dhimma waliigaltee irratti jijjiirama tasaa waan fideef, mariin daldalaa sun dhaabbachuu qaba jedhaniiru. Kanaan walqabatee, Ameerikaan oomishaalee Kaanaadaa irratti gibira haaraa kan feete yoo ta'u, kunis walitti dhufeenya biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiru kan hammeesse dha.

title: Inundated Philippine communities seek answers over flood control funds
english: Residents in the northern Philippines are frustrated and demanding accountability after severe monsoon flooding devastated their communities. Despite government claims of investing in flood control infrastructure, locals report that these measures failed to protect them. People are now questioning where the allocated funds for these projects went and why the systems remain ineffective.
amharic: በፊሊፒንስ ሰሜናዊ ክፍል የሚኖሩ ነዋሪዎች በደረሰባቸው ከባድ የጎርፍ አደጋ ምክንያት የተናደዱ ሲሆን መንግስትን ተጠያቂ እያደረጉ ነው። ለጎርፍ መከላከያ ስራዎች በጀት ተመድቦ እንደነበር ቢገለጽም፣ የተገነቡት መዋቅሮች ጥበቃ ማድረግ ባለመቻላቸው ህዝቡ ቅሬታውን እያሰማ ነው። ነዋሪዎቹ ለጎርፍ መከላከያ ፕሮጀክቶች የተመደበው ገንዘብ የት እንደገባ እና ስራዎቹ ለምን ውጤታማ እንዳልሆኑ ማወቅ ይፈልጋሉ።
oromo: Naannoo kaaba Filippiinsitti jiraattonni balaa lolaa cimaan isaan irra gaheen booda mootummaa irraa ibsa barbaadaa jiru. Mootummaan hojiilee ittisa lolaa irratti baajata ramadeera jedhee ibsuus, sirnoonni ijaaraman balaa kana ittisuu waan hin dandeenyeef uummanni aaruu irra jira. Jiraattonni kun maallaqni ittisa lolaaf ramadame eessa akka gahe fi maaliif hojiiwwan kunneen bu'a qabeessa akka hin taane gaaffii kaasaniiru.

title: Palestinian teen shot and killed in West Bank attack, UN responds
english: A 17-year-old Palestinian boy was killed and another individual was left in critical condition following an attack by settlers near Hebron in the occupied West Bank. In response, the United Nations has demanded better protection for Palestinian civilians and called for those responsible to face justice. This incident adds to a troubling increase in violence, with 22 Palestinians already killed in settler-related attacks throughout the current year.
amharic: በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ክፍል ሄብሮን አቅራቢያ በተፈጸመ የሰፋሪዎች ጥቃት የ17 ዓመት ፍልስጤማዊ ታዳጊ ተገደለ፣ ሌላ ግለሰብም ለከፍተኛ ጉዳት ተዳረገ። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት የፍልስጤም ሲቪሎች ጥበቃ እንዲደረግላቸው እና ወንጀለኞች ለፍርድ እንዲቀርቡ ጠይቋል። በዚህ ዓመት ብቻ በሰፋሪዎች ጥቃት የተገደሉ የፍልስጤማውያን ቁጥር 22 መድረሱ ሁኔታውን አሳሳቢ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Godina waldhabdee West Bank magaalaa Hebron biratti miidhaa qaqqabeen dargaggeessi umriinsaa waggaa 17 ta'e ajjeefameera, namni biraammoo miidhaa hamaaf saaxilameera. Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii lammiileen Falasxiin eegumsa akka argatanfi yakka raawwattoonni seeratti akka dhiyaatan gaafateera. Bara kana keessa qofa haleellaa qe'ee qaban kanaan Falasxiinonni 22 ajjeefamuun isaanii haalli kun akka hammaate agarsiisa.

title: Nigeria and the Sahel: A growing security divide
english: A diplomatic rift is growing between Nigeria and the Sahelian alliance of Burkina Faso, Mali, and Niger, which recently withdrew from the regional bloc ECOWAS. Tensions were highlighted by the brief detention of Nigerian air personnel in Burkina Faso after an emergency landing, reflecting deeper political instability in the region. Experts note that these security challenges are partly linked to historical regional instability, making it difficult for these neighboring nations to cooperate effectively against shared threats like armed militant groups.
amharic: በናይጄሪያ እና በቡርኪና ፋሶ፣ በማሊ እና በኒጀር አሊያንስ መካከል እየሰፋ የመጣው የዲፕሎማሲ ክፍተት በምዕራብ አፍሪካ የጋራ የጸጥታ ጥበቃ ስራዎችን አዳጋች አድርጎታል። በቅርቡ የናይጄሪያ አየር ኃይል አባላት በቡርኪና ፋሶ በአስቸኳይ ማረፊያ ምክንያት መታሰራቸው በሁለቱ ወገኖች መካከል ያለውን አለመግባባት ያሳያል። የክልሉ የጸጥታ ችግሮች ከሊቢያ የቀውስ ጊዜ ጀምሮ የነበሩ ሲሆን፣ አገራት በትብብር ካልሰሩ በአካባቢው ያሉ ታጣቂ ቡድኖችን መቆጣጠር እንደማይችሉ ባለሙያዎች ያስጠነቅቃሉ።
oromo: Naijeeriyaafi biyyoota Sahel (Burkiinaa Faasoo, Maalii fi Niijar) gidduutti wal dhabdeen siyaasaa guddachaa jiru nageenya naannichaa irratti dhiibbaa uumaa jira. Haalli kun erga biyyoonni kunneen gamtaa ECOWAS gadi lakkisanii booda kan hammaate yoo ta'u, hidhattoonni qilleensa Naijeeriyaaa tokko xiyyaarri isaanii Burkiinaa Faasoo keessatti dirqamaan erga qubatee booda to'annaa jala oolunsaa wal dhabdee kana caalaatti ifa taasiseera. Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, rakkoon nageenyaa kun koraa fi hidhattoota naannichaa to'achuuf biyyoonni kunneen walta'iinsaan hojjechuun isaanii barbaachisaa akka ta'e ibsu.

title: At least 13 Tunisians missing as migrant boat headed for Italy capsizes
english: A boat carrying migrants toward Italy sank off the coast of Tunisia, leaving at least 13 people missing. Only two individuals were rescued from the vessel after it capsized, with one survivor currently in critical condition. This incident highlights the ongoing dangers of Mediterranean crossings and follows growing concerns from human rights groups regarding EU-funded border policies in Tunisia.
amharic: ወደ ጣሊያን ሲጓዝ የነበረ ስደተኞችን የጫነ ጀልባ በቱኒዝያ የባህር ዳርቻ ላይ በመስጠሙ ቢያንስ 13 ሰዎች መጥፋታቸው ተሰምቷል። ጀልባዋ ከተገለበጠች በኋላ ሁለት ሰዎች ብቻ በሕይወት የተገኙ ሲሆን አንደኛው በጥብቅ የሕክምና ክትትል ላይ ይገኛል። ይህ አደጋ በሜዲትራኒያን ባህር በኩል የሚደረገው ጉዞ ያለውን ከፍተኛ አደጋ የሚያሳይ ሲሆን፣ በአውሮፓ ህብረት እና በቱኒዝያ መካከል ያለውን የድንበር ቁጥጥር ስምምነት በተመለከተ የተነሱ ቅሬታዎችንም ዳግም አጉልቶ አሳይቷል።
oromo: Dooniin baqattoota gara Xaaliyaanii geessu tokko qarqara galaana Tunisiyaatti yoo gadagadde, namoonni 13 ol ta'an akka bade himameera. Namoota doonicharra turan keessaa lama qofa lubbuun kan fayyan yoo ta'u, tokko isaanii haala fayyaa cimaa keessa jira. Balaan kun balaa doonii galaana Meditiraaniyaanii keessatti mudatu kan itti fufaa jiru yoo ta'u, walii galtee to'annoo daangaa kan gamtaa Awurooppaa fi Tunisiyaa gidduutti taasifame irratti komiin akka ka'u godheera.

title: US imposes 50% tariffs on $20bn worth of Canadian goods after talks fail
english: The United States has implemented a 50 percent tariff on $20 billion worth of Canadian goods following the collapse of recent trade negotiations in Washington. Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney criticized the move and vowed to impose equivalent retaliatory tariffs on American products. While U.S. officials blamed Canada for failing to finalize the agreement, the new taxes will specifically impact electronics, industrial machinery, and dairy imports.
amharic: በዋሽንግተን የተካሄዱ የንግድ ድርድሮች በመክሸፋቸው አሜሪካ በካናዳ ምርቶች ላይ የ50 በመቶ ቀረጥ መጣሏን አስታውቃለች። የካናዳ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ማርክ ካርኒ ይህንን ውሳኔ በመቃወም ሀገራቸውም በአሜሪካ ምርቶች ላይ ተመሳሳይ አጸፋዊ እርምጃ እንደምትወስድ አስታውቀዋል። የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት ውድቀቱ የካናዳ ነው ሲሉ የካናዳ መንግስት ደግሞ እርምጃውን በመቃወም አዳዲስ ቀረጦቹ በኤሌክትሮኒክስ፣ በማሽነሪዎች እና በወተት ተዋጽኦዎች ላይ ተጽእኖ እንደሚፈጥሩ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa mariin daldalaa Waashingtonitti taasifamaa ture erga fashaleen booda, meeshaalee Kaanaadaa gatiin isaanii dolaara biliyoona 20 ta'u irratti gibira dhibbeentaa 50 kaa'eera. Ministirri Muummee Kaanaadaa Maark Kaarnii murtee kana balaaleffachuun, Kaanaadaanis meeshaalee Ameerikaa irratti gibira wal-fakkaatu akka keettu dhaadataniiru. Gama mootummaa Ameerikaatiin mariin kun akka hin milkoofneef Kaanaadaa kan komatan yoo ta'u, gibirri haaraan kun immoo meeshaalee elektirooniksii, maashinoota warshaa fi oomishaalee aannanii irratti dhiibbaa uuma.

title: US judge strikes down Trump immigrant visa ban affecting 75 countries
english: A federal judge in Manhattan has overturned a Trump administration policy that halted immigrant visas for people from 75 nations. Judge Jeannette Vargas declared the ban unlawful, noting that the Secretary of State lacked the legal authority to override standard visa processing rules. The ruling follows a lawsuit by advocacy groups challenging the restrictions, which the government had implemented citing concerns about immigrants relying on public resources.
amharic: በማንሃተን የሚገኝ የፌደራል ዳኛ ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በ75 አገራት ላይ ጥለውት የነበረውን የስደተኞች ቪዛ እገዳ ውድቅ አድርገዋል። ዳኛ ጄኔት ቫርጋስ የእገዳው ውሳኔ ህገ-ወጥ መሆኑን በመግለጽ፣ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሩ የቪዛ አሰጣጥ ሂደቱን የመቆጣጠር ህጋዊ ስልጣን እንደሌላቸው አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው የመብት ተሟጋች ድርጅቶች እገዳው በህግ የተደነገገውን የቪዛ አሰራር የሚፃረር ነው በማለት ባቀረቡት ክስ መሠረት ነው።
oromo: Abbaan seeraa magaalaa Manhattan tokko, bulchiinsi pirezidaant Traamp biyyoota 75 irratti dhorkaa viizaa godhee ture haqeera. Abbaan seerichaa Jeannette Vargas dhorkaan kun seeraan alaa fi aangoo ministeera dhimma alaa kan darbe ta'uu mirkaneessaniiru. Murtii kana kan dabarsan gareewwan mirga namoomaa dhorkaan kun seera baqattummaa biyyattii waliin kan wal-faallessu ta'uu himatanii erga iyyatanii booda dha.

title: UK MP urges government to ban goods produced in West Bank settlements
english: Emily Thornberry, the chair of the UK's Foreign Affairs Committee, is calling on the government to ban goods imported from Israeli settlements in the West Bank. She argues that these settlements and rising violence are destroying the possibility of a two-state solution. Meanwhile, the UK government is planning to take measures against Israel for launching new construction projects that threaten to divide the West Bank.
amharic: የዩናይትድ ኪንግደም የውጭ ጉዳይ ኮሚቴ ሰብሳቢ ኤሚሊ ቶርንቤሪ፣ በምዕራብ ባንክ በሚገኙ የእስራኤል ሰፈራዎች የሚመረቱ ዕቃዎች ወደ እንግሊዝ እንዳይገቡ መንግሥት እንዲከለክል ጠይቀዋል። እነዚህ ሰፈራዎች እና እየተባባሰ የመጣው ግጭት ለሁለት ሀገራት መፍትሄ ትልቅ እንቅፋት መሆናቸውን አስረድተዋል። የእንግሊዝ መንግሥትም በበኩሉ፣ በምዕራብ ባንክ የመሬት ይዞታን የሚከፋፍሉ አዳዲስ የእስራኤል የግንባታ ፕሮጀክቶችን በመቃወም እርምጃ ለመውሰድ ማቀዱን ገልጿል።
oromo: Preezidaantiin Koree Dhimma Alaa Paarlaamaa UK, Eemilii Toornberi, mootummaan UK meeshaalee naannoo Waanx Baankiitti iddoo qubannaa Israa'elootaan oomishaman akka hin galchine gaafachaa jirti. Inni kun rakkoo nageenyaa fi qubannaan babal'achaa jiru fala biyya lamaa kan ta'e 'two-state solution' akka fashaleessu isheen ibsiteetti. Mootummaan UK gama isaatiin, ijaarsi haaraan Israa'el Waanx Baankii bakka lamatti qooduuf karoorfatte, nagaa fi tasgabbii naannichaa irratti balaa akka qabu ibsuun tarkaanfii fudhachuuf qophaa'aa jira.

title: Tanker traffic at Saudi Arabia's Yanbu port falls by a third, report says
english: Ship traffic at Saudi Arabia's Yanbu port has dropped significantly following the Houthi blockade in the Red Sea. To bypass this, Saudi Aramco is using a detour through the SUMED pipeline in Egypt to move its oil. Although this strategy maintains exports, it increases transportation costs and causes shipping delays for customers in Asia.
amharic: የየመን ሁቲዎች በቀይ ባህር ላይ ባደረጉት እገዳ ምክንያት በሳውዲ አረቢያ የያንቡ ወደብ የሚደረግ የነዳጅ ማመላለሻ መርከቦች እንቅስቃሴ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ቀንሷል። ይህንን ችግር ለመቅረፍ ሳውዲ አራምኮ የግብፅን የሱመድ የቧንቧ መስመር በመጠቀም ነዳጅን ወደ ውጭ እየላከ ይገኛል። ይህ አማራጭ የወጪ ንግዱ እንዲቀጥል ቢያደርገውም፣ ለኤስያ ገዢዎች የትራንስፖርት ጊዜንና ወጪን ጨምሯል።
oromo: Humni Huutii Yemenii daandii galaana diimaa cufuun isaa, geejjiba dooniiwwan boba'aa buufata Yanbuu kan Saudii Arabaa irratti dhiibbaa guddaa uumeera. Rakkoo kana hiikuuf, kampaniin Aramco boba'aa isaa biyyoota biraatti erguuf gara garaa daandii biyya Masrii fayyadamaa jira. Tarsiimoon kun oomisha biyyattii gabaa biyya alaa akka gahu godhus, gatii geejjibaa fi yeroo gabaa Asiyaa gahuu dheeressera.

title: Peru rescues people trapped by landslides on highway for nearly a week
english: Authorities in Peru have initiated helicopter rescue operations to assist dozens of people stranded for nearly a week. Heavy rains triggered landslides that damaged the Southern Coastal Highway in the Arequipa region, blocking traffic and leaving travelers stuck. Emergency teams are now working to evacuate those affected by the destruction.
amharic: የፔሩ ባለስልጣናት በአሬኪፓ አካባቢ ለስድስት ቀናት ያህል ተጣብቀው የቆዩ ሰዎችን በሄሊኮፕተር የማዳን ስራ ጀምረዋል። በከባድ ዝናብ ምክንያት የተከሰተው የመሬት መንሸራተት የደቡባዊ የባህር ዳርቻ አውራ ጎዳናን በማፍረሱ ተሽከርካሪዎች እና መንገደኞች መንገድ ላይ ቀርተው ነበር። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች በተጎዱ አካባቢዎች ያሉ ሰዎችን ለማዳን ጥረት እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Mootummaan Peru namoota naannoo Arequipa keessatti torban tokkoo oliif daandii irratti cufamanii turan helikopteriin oolchuuf sochiilee jalqabeera. Rooba cimaan lafti akka sigidduu fi daandiin guddaan gammoojjii kibbaa akka cufamu gochuun, konkolaattotaa fi namoota hedduu daandii irratti akka hafan godheera. Gareewwan hatattamaa namoota miidhaan irra ga'e kana bakka rakkoo irraa baasuuf hojjetaa jiru.

title: Palestinian-British girl, 6, dies days after family drowned off UK coast
english: A six-year-old Palestinian-British girl has passed away in the hospital following a tragic drowning incident at a beach in Sussex, UK. Her parents and teenage sister had already lost their lives at the scene earlier this week during a family trip amid a summer heatwave. Local authorities are investigating the event as a tragic accident with no signs of external involvement.
amharic: በእንግሊዝ ሰሴክስ የባህር ዳርቻ ላይ በተፈጠረ አሳዛኝ የመስጠም አደጋ የስድስት ዓመቷ የፍልስጤም-ብሪቲሽ ህጻን በሆስፒታል ህክምናዋን ስትከታተል ቆይታ ህይወቷ አልፏል። የህጻኗ ወላጆች እና የአስራ አራት ዓመት እህቷ ቀደም ብለው በዚሁ አደጋ ህይወታቸው ማለፉ ይታወሳል። የሀገሪቱ ፖሊስ አደጋው የደረሰው በከፍተኛ ሙቀት ወቅት ቤተሰቡ ለጉብኝት በሄዱበት ወቅት እንደሆነ ገልጾ፣ በምንም አይነት ወንጀል የተፈጠረ ሳይሆን ድንገተኛ አደጋ እንደሆነ አስታውቋል።
oromo: Mucaan waggaa ja'aa kan taate dubartiin lammii Palastine fi Biriteen taate tokko, qarqara galaana Sussex, UK irratti mudateen erga bishaan keessatti liqimfamtee booda hospitaala keessatti lubbuun ishee darbeera. Obboleettiin ishee waggaa kudha afurii fi warri ishee kanaan dura bakka sanaatti du'uu isaanii gabaasni ni ibsa. Poolisiin naannichaa akka jedhetti, lammiileen kunneen ho'a qilleensaa cimaa sana keessa bakka sanatti boqonnaa fudhachuuf kan dhaqan yoo ta'u, duuti kun balaa tasaa malee kan biraa akka hin jirre ibseera.

title: 'We have more work to do', says Canada negotiator as US trade deadline looms
english: Canadian officials are working intensely in Washington to finalize a trade agreement with the US before a critical midnight deadline. Negotiators are aiming to avoid new tariffs, while discussing potential concessions such as opening the Canadian dairy market and reducing levies on steel and automobiles. Prime Minister Justin Trudeau's government faces internal pressure to ensure the deal remains fair for Canadian industries as talks continue down to the wire.
amharic: የካናዳ ተወካዮች ከአሜሪካ ጋር የንግድ ስምምነት ለመፈራረም በዋሽንግተን ከፍተኛ ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው። የሁለቱ ሀገራት ድርድር የአሜሪካን የጉምሩክ ቀረጥ ለማስቀረት ያለመ ሲሆን፣ በካናዳ የወተት ምርቶች ገበያ እና በብረታ ብረት ላይ የሚጣሉ ቀረጦችን የሚመለከቱ ውይይቶች እየተካሄዱ ነው። የካናዳ መንግስት ስምምነቱ ለሀገሪቱ ኢንዱስትሪዎች ጠቃሚ እንዲሆን ግፊት ቢኖርበትም፣ የመጨረሻ ሰዓት ላይ የሚደረገው ድርድር አሁንም ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Kaanaadaa waliigaltee daldalaa Ameerikaa waliin qaban xumuruuf magaalaa Waashingitanitti carraaqqii cimaa gochaa jiru. Mariin kun gibira daldalaa haaraa Ameerikaa irraa dhufu hambisuuf kan karoorfame yoo ta'u, qonnaa aannanii fi oomisha sibiilaa irratti jijjiirama gochuuf marii irra jiru. Mootummaan Kaanaadaa waliigaltee kana biyya isaaniitiif faayidaa qabeessa taasisuuf dhiibbaa keessoo fi alaa jiru dandamachaa marii isaanii itti fufaniiru.

title: TikTok to pay $400m to US in one of largest child privacy settlements
english: TikTok has agreed to a $400 million settlement with the U.S. government to resolve a lawsuit regarding the illegal collection of data from children under 13. The case alleged that the platform violated federal privacy laws by failing to secure parental consent for its younger users. As part of the agreement, the company is required to make payments to the Department of Justice and continue improving its safety practices for minors.
amharic: ቲክቶክ ከ13 ዓመት በታች የሆኑ ህጻናትን መረጃ ያለ ህጋዊ ፈቃድ በመሰብሰብ ክስ እንደቀረበበት በመግለጽ ለዩናይትድ ስቴትስ መንግስት 400 ሚሊዮን ዶላር ለመክፈል ተስማምቷል። ይህ ስምምነት ኩባንያው የህጻናትን ግላዊነት የሚጠብቁ የፌዴራል ህጎችን ባለማክበሩ የተደረገ ነው። እንደ ስምምነቱ ከሆነ ቲክቶክ ክፍያውን ከመፈጸም በተጨማሪ ለታዳጊ ተጠቃሚዎቹ የሚሰጠውን የደህንነት ጥበቃ ማሻሻል ይጠበቅበታል።
oromo: Tiik-tok (TikTok) ijoollee waggaa 13 gadi ta'an irraa odeeffannoo seeraan ala walitti qabuun himatamee, mootummaa Yuunaayitid Isteetsiif qarshii miiliyoona 400 kaffaluuf walii galeera. Himannaan kun kan ka'e, dhaabbatichi seera eegumsa icitii ijoollee cabsee hayyama warra ijoolleetiin alatti odeeffannoo sassaabuun isaa ibsamee ture. Walii galtee kanaan, dhaabbatichi kaffaltii kana raawwachuun cinaatti, eegumsa nageenyaa fayyadamtoota isaa xixiqqoo irratti fooyyessa gochuuf dirqameera.

title: Iranian president says time to end war with US from ‘position of strength’
english: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has advocated for concluding the ongoing conflict with the United States, asserting that Iran is currently in a position of strength. While the president seeks to defend recent diplomatic efforts from domestic critics, the Iranian military continues to issue warnings of a severe response to any potential threats. Meanwhile, international diplomatic efforts are underway, with Oman mediating discussions to address shipping disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz and encourage a resumption of negotiations.
amharic: የኢራን ፕሬዚዳንት መስኡድ ፔዘሽኪያን አገራቸው በኃይል ደረጃ ላይ እንደምትገኝ በመግለጽ ከአሜሪካ ጋር ያለውን ግጭት በአሁኑ ወቅት ማቆም እንደሚገባ ተናግረዋል። ፕሬዚዳንቱ የቅርብ ጊዜ የዲፕሎማሲ ጥረቶችን ከአገር ውስጥ ተቺዎች ቢከላከሉም፣ የኢራን ወታደራዊ አመራሮች ግን በማንኛውም ስጋት ላይ ከፍተኛ አጸፋ እንደሚሰጡ እያስጠነቀቁ ይገኛሉ። በሌላ በኩል ኦማን በሆርሙዝ ባህር ወሽመጥ ላይ የተፈጠረውን የትራፊክ መስተጓጎል ለመፍታት እና ድርድሩን ለማስቀጠል መካከለኛ ሆና እየሰራች ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Iraan Masuud Pezeeshkiyaan, biyyi isaanii bakka humnaa irra jirti jechuun waraana Yuuniited Isteetsii waliin jiru xumuruun akka barbaachisu ibsaniiru. Pirezidaantichi yaaliiwwan dippiloomaasii dhiyootti godhaman mormitoota biyya keessaa irraa ittisuuf yaalaniyyu, raayyaan ittisa biyyattii garuu sodaachisa kamiyyuu irratti tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuuf qophii ta'uu akeekkachiisaa jiru. Gammachuu kanaan, biyyi Omaan rakkoo geejjiba galaanaa lafa dhiphoo Hormuz irratti mudate furuufi mariin akka itti fufuuf giddu galeessummaa gochaa jirti.

title: California lawmaker overcomes pro-Israel spending to win special election
english: Progressive candidate Aisha Wahab has won a special election in California, securing her position as the first Afghan American in Congress. She achieved this victory despite significant campaign spending against her by pro-Israel interest groups. Wahab, who has previously called for an end to the war in Gaza, will represent the 14th district for the remainder of the current term.
amharic: ተራማጅ እጩ አይሻ ዋሃብ በካሊፎርኒያ በተካሄደ ልዩ ምርጫ በማሸነፍ በአሜሪካ ኮንግረስ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ የተመረጡ አፍጋኒስታናዊ አሜሪካዊ ሆነዋል። የእስራኤል ደጋፊ ቡድኖች በእርሷ ላይ ከፍተኛ ገንዘብ አውጥተው ዘመቻ ቢያደርጉም ውጤቱን መቀልበስ አልቻሉም። የጋዛን ጦርነት በመቃወም የምትታወቀው ዋሃብ፣ የቀድሞውን የኮንግረስ አባል ኤሪክ ስዋልዌልን በመተካት የ14ኛውን ዲስትሪክት ወክለው ይሰራሉ።
oromo: Duula filannoo addaa Kaaliifoorniyaa keessatti, kaadhimamtuun dura-deemtuu Aisha Wahab injifannoo argachuun namtittii Afgaan-Ameerikaa jalqabaa gara Koongirasii biyyattii seenuu taateetti. Gareewwan Israa'el deggaran maallaqa hedduu baasuun duula ishee irratti geggeessaniyyuu injifannoo kana galmeessisuu dandeesseetti. Wahab, kan waraana Gaazaatiin mormitu, bakka buutuun durii Eric Swalwell bakka buutee hanga dhuma bara hojii isaatti kutaa 14ffaa bakka buutee akka tajaajiltu eegama.

title: Guyana’s Rodrigues Birkett leads informal poll in race to be next UN leader
english: Guyanese Ambassador Carolyn Rodrigues Birkett has taken the lead in the second informal poll to select the next UN Secretary-General. She outperformed seven other candidates, including the previous frontrunner, as the Security Council works to find a successor for Antonio Guterres before his term ends in December. These non-binding votes are helping the council narrow down the field of applicants before a formal recommendation is finalized.
amharic: የጉያናው አምባሳደር ካሮሊን ሮድሪገስ ቢርኬት፣ ቀጣዩ የተባበሩት መንግስታት ዋና ጸሐፊ ለመሆን በሚደረገው መደበኛ ያልሆነ የምርጫ ሂደት ግንባር ቀደም ሆነዋል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት የጸጥታው ምክር ቤት የአንቶኒዮ ጉቴሬዝን የስራ ዘመን ማብቂያ ተከትሎ አዲስ መሪ ለመምረጥ በሚያደርገው ጥረት፣ እሳቸው ከሌሎች ሰባት እጩዎች የተሻለ ድጋፍ አግኝተዋል። እነዚህ የምርጫ ሂደቶች የመጨረሻ ውሳኔ ከመሰጠቱ በፊት እጩዎችን ቁጥር ለመቀነስ የሚረዱ ናቸው።
oromo: Ambaasaaddarri Guyyaanaa Kaaroliin Rodriges Birkeet, bakka bu'aa dhaabbata mootummoota gamtoomaniitiif itti aanee filamuuf adeemsa filannoo hin-seera-qabeessa keessatti dursaa jiru. Mana maree naga eegumsaa keessatti akkaataa filannoo kanatti fayyadamuun, yeroon Antooniyoo Guuteereez dhuma waggaa kanaa waan xumuramuuf, bakka bu'aa isaanii barbaaduuf carraaqqii taasifamaa jiru. Filannoon kun hirmaattota filannoo gidduutti deggarsa jiru madaaluufi namoota gita kanaaf dorgoman hir'isuuf kan gargaaruudha.

title: Several killed in Russia’s ‘double-tap’ drone strike on Ukraine mall
english: A Russian drone attack on a shopping center in Kryvyi Rih, Ukraine, has resulted in at least 16 deaths and over 130 injuries. The incident involved a 'double-tap' strategy, where a second strike was intentionally timed to hit emergency workers responding to the first explosion. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy condemned the assault as a cowardly and calculated act of violence.
amharic: ሩሲያ በዩክሬን ክሪቪ ሪህ ከተማ በሚገኝ የገበያ ማዕከል ባደረሰችው የድሮን ጥቃት ቢያንስ 16 ሰዎች ተገድለው ከ130 በላይ የሚሆኑት ቆስለዋል። ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመው የመጀመሪያው ፍንዳታ ከተከሰተ በኋላ ለማዳን የደረሱትን የድንገተኛ አደጋ ሠራተኞች ለማጥቃት ታቅዶ በተከታታይ በሁለት ዙር ነው። የዩክሬኑ ፕሬዝዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘለንስኪ ይህንን ድርጊት ፈሪሃ እና የታቀደ የኃይል እርምጃ በማለት አውግዘውታል።
oromo: Raashiyaan magaalaa Ukreyn Kriivii Riih keessatti bakka gabaa tokko irratti xiyyaara nama hin feene (drone) fayyadamtee erga weerartee booda, namoonni 16 du'anii fi 130 ol ta'an miidhamaniiru. Weerarti kun 'double-tap' ykn rukuttaa lammaffaa kan fayyadame yoo ta'u, kunis gargaarsaaf namoota dhufan irratti xiyyeeffachuun kan raawwatame dha. Pirezidaantiin Ukreyn Volodimir Zeelenski weerara kana gocha sodaataa fi karoora qabu jechuun balaaleffataniiru.

title: Iran war live: Trump says he views Strait of Hormuz as ‘American territory’
english: President Donald Trump has controversially claimed the Strait of Hormuz as American territory amid ongoing tensions with Iran. While Trump suggested that Iran is interested in reaching an agreement, he believes they are not yet prepared to offer a suitable deal. In response, Iran's Foreign Minister dismissed recent American economic threats and sanctions, asserting that such measures will ultimately be unsuccessful.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በኢራን ላይ በሚደረገው ውጥረት መካከል የሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤን እንደ አሜሪካ ግዛት እንደሚመለከቱት በይፋ ተናግረዋል። ትራምፕ ኢራን ስምምነት ለመፈጸም ፍላጎት እንዳላት ቢገልጹም፣ እስካሁን ትክክለኛውን ውል ለመፈረም ዝግጁ አይደሉም ብለው እንደሚያምኑ ገልጸዋል። የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር በበኩላቸው የአሜሪካን የኢኮኖሚ ጫና እና ማዕቀብ ውድቅ በማድረግ፣ እነዚህ እርምጃዎች ውጤታማ እንደማይሆኑ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Pirezedaantiin Doonaald tiraampii walitti bu'iinsa Iraan wajjin jiru gidduutti, daandiin galaana Hormuz kan Ameerikaati jedhanii dubbataniiru. Tiraampiin Iraan walii galtee uumuu akka barbaaddu ibsanis, hanga ammaatti waliigaltee sirrii ta'e tokkoof qophii akka hin taane amanu. Gama biraatiin, ministirri dhimma alaa Iraan, doorsisa dinagdee fi adabbii Ameerikaa kanaan dura irra kaa'ame akka hin fudhanne ibsuun, tarkaanfiin kun bu'aa akka hin qabne dubbataniiru.

title: Myanmar military bombing kills 14 at Buddhist monastery, opposition reports
english: A Myanmar military airstrike recently targeted a Buddhist monastery in the Sagaing region, resulting in at least 14 deaths and injuring 20 others. The attack occurred while over 100 people were gathered at the site for a religious retreat during Buddhist Lent. This incident is part of the ongoing civil war that has gripped the country since the military coup in 2021, leading to massive displacement and loss of life.
amharic: የማይንማር ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በሳጋይን ክልል በሚገኝ የቡድሂስት ገዳም ላይ ባደረሱት የአየር ጥቃት ቢያንስ 14 ሰዎች ሲገደሉ 20 ሰዎች ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። ጥቃቱ የተፈፀመው ከ100 በላይ ሰዎች በቡድሂስት በዓል ምክንያት በገዳሙ ውስጥ በተሰበሰቡበት ወቅት ነው። ይህ አሳዛኝ ድርጊት እ.ኤ.አ. ከ2021 ወታደራዊ መፈንቅለ መንግስት በኋላ ሀገሪቱን እያመሰ ካለው የእርስ በርስ ጦርነት አንዱ አካል ነው።
oromo: Humnootni waraana Myanmar naannoo Sagaayinitti gara manaa amantii buddistotaa qilleensarraa boombii darbachuun, namoota 14 ajjeesanii 20 immoo madoo godhaniiru. Hojiin badii kun kan raawwatame namoonni 100 ol ta'an ayyaana amantii kabajuuf walitti qabamanii jiranitti. Rakkoon kun waraana biyyattii keessatti waggoota darban keessa gaggeeffamaa jiru fi namoota baay'ee buqqise kan jabaate dha.

title: Editor of US newspaper Stars and Stripes reportedly fired under Trump
english: The Pentagon has dismissed the editor-in-chief and a top reporter from the U.S. military newspaper Stars and Stripes. Editor Erik Slavin believes he was fired in retaliation for publicly defending the publication's editorial independence against potential censorship. This action occurs amid growing concerns that the Trump administration is increasingly restricting press freedom and challenging media organizations.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መከላከያ ሚኒስቴር (ፔንታጎን) የስታርስ ኤንድ ስትራይፕስ ወታደራዊ ጋዜጣ ዋና አዘጋጅን እና አንድ ከፍተኛ ጋዜጠኛን ከሥራ አሰናብቷል። ዋና አዘጋጁ ኤሪክ ስላቪን ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው የጋዜጣውን ነጻነት ከሳንሱር ለመከላከል በመናገራቸው እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። ይህ ክስተት የትራምፕ አስተዳደር በፕሬስ ነጻነት ላይ ጫና እያሳደረ ነው በሚል ሥጋት በተጋረጠበት ወቅት መፈጠሩ ትኩረትን ስቧል።
oromo: Ministeerri ittisaa Ameerikaa (Pentaagoon) gabaasa waraanaa 'Stars and Stripes' jedhamuun beekamu keessatti qindeessaa olaanaa fi gabaasaa tokko hojiirraa ari'eera. Qindeessaan kun Erik Slaaviin, tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame walaba ta'uu qopheessummaa gaazexichaa eeguuf waan dubbateef akka ta'e amana. Tarkaanfiin kun mootummaan Traamp bilisummaa miidiyaa irratti dhiibbaa gochaa jira jedhamee yaaddoo jiru gidduutti raawwatame.

title: Outrage in India over death of six-year-old ‘slapped’ by his teacher
english: A six-year-old student named Pranay Tej died in India after being slapped by his teacher inside a classroom. The incident was recorded on school security cameras, sparking widespread public anger and calls for an end to corporal punishment. Government authorities have launched a formal investigation and pledged to hold the school management and the teacher accountable for the tragedy.
amharic: በህንድ በአንድ ትምህርት ቤት አስተማሪዋ በደረሰባት ድብደባ የስድስት ዓመት ህጻን ህይወት አልፏል። ድርጊቱ በትምህርት ቤቱ የደህንነት ካሜራ የተቀረጸ ሲሆን፣ ህዝባዊ ቁጣን በማቀጣጠል በካፊያ የሚደረግ የቅጣት እርምጃ እንዲቆም ጥሪ ቀርቧል። የመንግስት አካላት ጉዳዩን በቁም ነገር በመያዝ በአስተማሪዋና በትምህርት ቤት አስተዳደሩ ላይ ምርመራ መጀመራቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Indiyaatti mucaan umriin isaa waggaa jahaa barattuu tokkoon erga reebamee booda lubbuun isaa darbeera. Gochi kun kaameeraa nageenyaa mana barumsichaa irratti kan waraabame yoo ta'u, lammiileen hedduun gocha kana balaaleffachuun daa'imman irratti reebichi akka dhaabatu gaafachaa jiru. Abbootiin taayitaa mootummaa qorannoo eegalanii, barsiistuu fi bulchiinsa mana barumsichaa irratti tarkaanfiin seeraa akka fudhatamu waadaa galaniiru.

title: Israeli forces make fresh incursion into Syria's Quneitra, search home
english: Israeli military forces recently entered the al-Basali village in Syria’s Quneitra region to search a private home before retreating. This incident is part of a growing pattern of frequent incursions, house raids, and civilian detentions in the area since Israel began moving troops into the UN-monitored buffer zone in 2024. These repeated operations have caused rising tensions, including recent fires and the ongoing arrest of local residents.

english: Former President Donald Trump recently declared the Strait of Hormuz to be American territory during a campaign rally. He also emphasized that the United States must prevent Iran from acquiring nuclear weapons to avoid dangerous consequences. Trump suggested he is currently hesitant to pursue a new deal with Iran despite their interest.

title: Georgia declines to join new EU sanctions against Iran
english: Georgia has officially refused to participate in the most recent European Union sanctions imposed on Iran. Government officials stated that the country prioritizes its own national interests when deciding whether to support international measures. They also noted that other nations like Turkey and Serbia have similarly chosen not to align with these specific EU policies.

title: Centcom says 68 vessels redirected so far in Iran naval blockade
english: The U.S. military is currently enforcing a naval blockade against Iran using a fleet of over 20 warships. So far, American forces have intercepted 68 commercial ships, forcing them to change course, while disabling three and boarding two others. This operation is part of a broader strategy involving harsh new economic sanctions.

title: Pro-Gaza flotilla arrives in Albania in support of 'Flamingo Revolution'
english: Pro-Palestinian activists have sailed from Italy to Albania using boats previously damaged during a mission to Gaza to support the Flamingo Revolution. The protest opposes a luxury resort development planned by Jared Kushner on an Albanian island, citing concerns about environmental damage and land rights. This arrival is symbolically linked to the 1991 migration crisis, as some descendants of those who once fled to Italy have returned to protect their ancestral lands.

title: US debt tops $40 trillion, Americans left with the bill
english: The United States national debt has officially exceeded $40 trillion for the first time. This unprecedented figure highlights the rapid growth of the country's financial obligations. Consequently, American citizens are now facing the long-term impact and economic burden of this mounting debt.

title: TikTok settles with US Justice Department for $400m over child privacy laws
english: TikTok has agreed to pay a $400 million settlement to the U.S. government after being accused of violating laws meant to protect children's online privacy. As part of the resolution, TikTok has committed to improving its safety measures to better safeguard young users on the platform.

english: A tragic incident occurred at a Swedish high school where an attacker armed with a sword killed one person and injured three others. Law enforcement officials have arrested an 18-year-old suspect in connection with the violence. Authorities are currently conducting an investigation to determine the motive behind the assault.
amharic: ስዊድን ውስጥ በሚገኝ አንድ ሁለተኛ ደረጃ ትምህርት ቤት ሰይፍ በያዘ ሰው በተፈጸመ ጥቃት አንድ ሰው ሲሞት ሌሎች ሶስት ሰዎች ቆስለዋል። የሀገሪቱ ፖሊስ ጥቃቱን ፈጽሟል የተባለውን የ18 ዓመት ወጣት በቁጥጥር ስር አውሏል። የጥቃቱ መነሻ ምክንያት ምን እንደሆነ ለማወቅ ምርመራ እየተካሄደ ይገኛል።
oromo: mana barumsaa sadarkaa lammaffaa Iswidish keessatti namni goraadee hidhate tokko miidhaa geessiseen namni tokko yoo du'u, sadii immoo madaa'aniiru. Poolisiin namicha umuriinsaa waggaa 18 ta'e kan yakka kana raawwate jedhamee shakkamu to'annaa jala oolchera. Qaamoleen nageenyaa sababii miidhaan kun itti raawwatame qorachuuf hojjechaa jiru.

title: Arsenal rout Coventry 3-0 to begin Premier League title defence in style
english: Arsenal kicked off their Premier League title defense with a dominant 3-0 victory against newly promoted Coventry at the Emirates Stadium. Goals from Kai Havertz, Bukayo Saka, and Martin Odegaard secured a comfortable win for Mikel Arteta’s team. This impressive performance signals that the reigning champions are well-prepared to compete for another trophy this season.
amharic: አርሰናል አዲሱን የፕሪሚየር ሊግ የውድድር ዘመን በኤምሬትስ ስታዲየም አዲስ አዳጊውን ኮቨንትሪን 3 ለ 0 በማሸነፍ በድል ጀምሯል። የካይ ሃቨርትዝ፣ የቡካዮ ሳካ እና የማርቲን ኦዴጋርድ ግቦች ለሚኬል አርቴታ ቡድን ምቹ ድል አስገኝተዋል። ይህ ጠንካራ አጀማመር የሊጉ ባለቤት የሆነው አርሰናል ዋንጫውን ለማስጠበቅ በከፍተኛ ዝግጅት ላይ እንደሚገኝ ያሳያል።
oromo: Arsenal taphattoota liigii Ingilizii haaraa Coventry 3-0 injifachuun xumura gaariin eegaleera. Galchiiwwan Kai Havertz, Bukayo Saka fi Martin Odegaard taphicha milkaa'aa taasiseera. Injifannoon kun qophiin Arsenal mootii ta'uusaanii itti fufuuf qaban akka jabaa ta'e agarsiisa.

title: Global Sumud Flotilla joins Albania’s anti-resort protest
english: The Global Sumud Flotilla has docked in Vlore, Albania, to show solidarity with local activists protesting a proposed luxury resort project. The protesters, part of the 'Flamingo Revolution,' are concerned that the development—which has ties to Jared Kushner—will lead to environmental destruction and the loss of local land. The activists draw direct comparisons between their struggle against the resort and broader global issues regarding land rights and conservation.
amharic: የግሎባል ሱሙድ ፍሎቲላ የተባለው ቡድን በአልባኒያ በታቀደው የቅንጦት ሪዞርት ግንባታ ላይ የሚደረገውን ተቃውሞ ለመደገፍ ወደ ቭሎሬ ከተማ አቅንተዋል። በ'ፍላሚንጎ አብዮት' የሚታወቁት እነዚህ ተቃዋሚዎች ከጃሬድ ኩሽነር ጋር ግንኙነት ያለው ይህ ፕሮጀክት አካባቢን እንደሚጎዳ እና የመሬት ይዞታ መብታቸውን እንደሚጋፋ ይከራከራሉ። ተቃዋሚዎቹ ለራሳቸው መሬት መብት እና ለአካባቢ ጥበቃ ያላቸውን ስጋት በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ካሉ የመብት ጥያቄዎች ጋር አያይዘውታል።
oromo: Garee Global Sumud Flotilla jedhamu, mormii jiraattonni magaalaa Vlore, Albaniyaa, pirojektii mana boqonnaa qananii ijaaruu irratti kaasan deggaruuf achi ga'aniiru. Mormitoonni 'Flamingo Revolution' jedhamanii beekaman kun, ijaarsi kun kan Jared Kushner wajjin walqabatu waan ta'eef, naannichatti miidhaa qilleensaa fi dhabamsiisa lafaa fida jedhanii sodaatu. Namoonni kun qabsoo isaanii kana mirga lafaa fi eegumsa naannoo ilaalchisee rakkoolee addunyaa irratti mul'atan wajjin walqabsiisu.

title: Israel launches attacks in southern Lebanon
english: Israeli military aircraft conducted multiple airstrikes across various locations in southern Lebanon, including the Ali al-Taher ridge. Additional reports indicate that areas near Deir Siryan, Doha Kafr Rumman, and al-Mansouri were also targeted. These military actions took place in quick succession within the Nabatieh province.
amharic: የእስራኤል የጦር አውሮፕላኖች በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በሚገኙ የተለያዩ አካባቢዎች ላይ ተከታታይ የአየር ጥቃት ፈጽመዋል። ጥቃቶቹ የአሊ አል-ታሄር ኮረብታን ጨምሮ በዴይር ሲሪያን፣ በዶሃ ካፍር ሩማን እና በአል-ማንሱሪ አካባቢዎች ላይ ያነጣጠሩ ነበሩ። እነዚህ ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴዎች በናባቲህ ግዛት ውስጥ በተደጋጋሚ ተካሂደዋል።
oromo: Xiyyaarotni waraana Israa'eel kibba Libaanoos keessatti bakkeewwan garaagaraatti rukuttaa qilleensaarraa raawwataniiru. Haleellaan kunneen tulluu Ali al-Taher dabalatee, naannawa Deir Siryan, Doha Kafr Rumman fi al-Mansouri irratti xiyyeeffatanii kan gaggeeffamanidha. Tarkaanfiiwwan waraanaa kunneenis naannoo Nabatieh keessatti walitti aansuudhaan raawwatamaniiru.

title: Indian workers in Israel demand accountability after murder of Indian caregiver
english: Indian workers in Israel are demanding justice following the fatal stabbing of Rajeev Acharya, an Indian caregiver killed by his employer's grandson. The suspect has been formally charged with premeditated murder, and Indian authorities are monitoring the ongoing investigation. This incident has raised significant concerns regarding the safety and vulnerability of foreign workers living in private homes throughout Israel.
amharic: በእስራኤል የሚሰሩ የህንድ ዜጎች፣ ራጂቭ አቻሪያ የተባለ የህንድ ተንከባካቢ በአሰሪው የልጅ ልጅ ከተገደለ በኋላ ፍትህ እንዲሰፍን እየጠየቁ ነው። ተጠርጣሪው በታቀደ ግድያ ወንጀል ክስ የተመሰረተበት ሲሆን፣ የህንድ መንግስትም ጉዳዩን በቅርበት እየተከታተለ ይገኛል። ይህ አሰቃቂ ድርጊት በእስራኤል በሚኖሩ የውጭ ሀገር ሰራተኞች ደህንነት ላይ ስጋትን ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Hojjettoonni Hindi Isiraa'el keessa jiran, gargaaraa maatii Hindi kan ta'e Rajeev Acharya, ilmoo ijoollee nama isa qaxarateen ajjeefamee booda haqni akka kennamu gaafachaa jiru. Shakkamichi ajjeechaa karooraan raawwatamee jedhamee himatameera, mootummaan Hindis qorannicha hordofaa jira. Ajjeechaan kun hojjettoota biyya alaa manneen keessa hojjetanirratti soda guddaa uumee jira.

title: EU's von der Leyen joins European countries to condemn Israel's West Bank plan
english: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen has joined several European nations in criticizing Israel's move to invite bids for new settlement construction in the West Bank. Leaders argue that the E1 project is unacceptable because it disrupts Palestinian territory and threatens the viability of a two-state solution. The EU and several key countries have long maintained their opposition to this specific expansion plan.
amharic: የአውሮፓ ኮሚሽን ፕሬዝዳንት ኡርሱላ ቮን ደር ሌየን በእስራኤል ቁጥጥር ስር ባለው ዌስት ባንክ አዳዲስ ሰፈራዎችን ለመገንባት በወጣው ጨረታ ላይ ሌሎች የአውሮፓ ሀገራትን በመቀላቀል ተቃውሞአቸውን ገልጸዋል። የኢ-1 ፕሮጀክት የፍልስጤም መሬትን የሚከፋፍል በመሆኑ ለሁለት ሀገራት መፍትሄ እንቅፋት እንደሚሆን አውሮፓውያን መሪዎች ይናገራሉ። አውሮፓ ህብረት ይህንን የእስራኤል እቅድ ለረጅም ጊዜ ሲቃወም መቆየቱም ተመላክቷል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Komishinii Awurooppaa Ursula von der Leyen, Israa'el naannoo weeraramee jiru West Baank keessatti ijaarsa qubata haaraa geggeessuuf karoorashee mormuun biyyoota Awurooppaa biroo waliin hiriirtetti. Karoorri I-1 kun lafa Falasxiin gargar cicciree furmaata biyyoota lamaa gufachiisuu danda'a jedhanii mormu. Gamtaan Awurooppaa fi biyyoonni guguddaan karoora kana waggoota dheeraaf mormaa turuun ni yaadatama.

title: Iran’s Ghalibaf: ‘We stay out of Iraq’s affairs’
english: Iranian parliamentary leader Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf has stated that his country does not involve itself in Iraq's domestic issues. He emphasized that Iran will back any political arrangement reached between Iraqi factions and their government. This declaration comes as Iraq faces a set timeline to incorporate various paramilitary groups into its official security forces.
amharic: የኢራን ፓርላማ አፈ ጉባኤ መሐመድ ባጌር ጋሊባፍ ኢራን በኢራቅ የውስጥ ጉዳዮች ጣልቃ እንደማትገባ አስታውቀዋል። በኢራቅ መንግስትና በተለያዩ የፖለቲካ ቡድኖች መካከል ለሚደረግ ማንኛውም ስምምነት ድጋፋቸውን እንደሚሰጡም ገልጸዋል። ይህ አስተያየት የተሰጠው ኢራቅ ሁሉንም የጥበቃ ቡድኖች ወደ መንግስት የጸጥታ መዋቅር ለማካተት የጊዜ ገደብ ባወጣችበት ወቅት ነው።
oromo: Hoggantoonni mana maree biyyattii Iraan, Mohammad Baager Gaalibaaf, biyyi isaanii dhimmoota keessoo Iraaq keessa akka hin galle ibsaniiru. Mootummaan Iraaq fi gareeleen biyyattii waliigaltee kamiyyuu yoo godhan akka deggeran ibsaniiru. Ibsi kun kan kenname yeroo mootummaan Iraaq gareewwan hidhattootaa hunda caasaa nageenyaa mootummaatti akka makaman murteessetti.

title: US elections: Aisha Wahab becomes first Afghan-American in Congress
english: Aisha Wahab has made history as the first Afghan-American elected to the United States Congress after winning a tight race in California. She defeated her opponent despite significant financial opposition from pro-Israel lobbying groups. Wahab will fill the remainder of a vacant term and is also preparing to run for a full two-year seat in the upcoming November general election.
amharic: አኢሻ ዋሃብ በካሊፎርኒያ በተደረገ የምርጫ ውድድር በማሸነፍ የመጀመሪያዋ አፍጋኒስታናዊት አሜሪካዊት የዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ኮንግረስ አባል በመሆን ታሪክ ሰርታለች። እሷም ከእስራኤል ደጋፊ ቡድኖች የገንዘብ ተጽዕኖ ቢደረግባትም ተፎካካሪዋን ማሸነፍ ችላለች። አኢሻ ዋሃብ የቀረውን የአገልግሎት ዘመን በማሟላት በህዳር ወር በሚካሄደው ዋና ምርጫ ለሁለት ዓመት የሙሉ ጊዜ የኮንግረስ አባልነት ለመወዳደር እየተዘጋጀች ትገኛለች።
oromo: Aisha Wahab seenaa hojjechaa, kan jalqabaa Afgaan-Ameerikaa ta'uun Mana Maree Ameerikaa keessatti filatamteetti. Isheenis yaalii garee Israa'el deggaran biraa ishee kuffisuuf taasifame keessatti injifannoo argatteetti. Wahab bakka namni biraa gadi dhiise guutuun kan itti fuftu yoo ta'u, filannoo guddicha kan Sadaasaa irratti sadarkaa guutuu isaanii irratti dorgomuuf qophaa'aa jirti.

title: Tunisian protesters call for President Kais Saied to step down
english: Hundreds of protesters gathered in Tunisia's capital to demand the resignation of President Kais Saied. Organizers from the Nafas Movement led the demonstration to express public frustration regarding ongoing power outages and the surging cost of living. This event highlights growing dissatisfaction with the current government's handling of the country's economic challenges.
amharic: በቱኒዝያ ዋና ከተማ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ተቃዋሚዎች የፕሬዝዳንት ካይስ ሰኢድ ከስልጣን እንዲለቁ በመጠየቅ ሰልፍ ወጥተዋል። ሰልፈኞቹ የናፋስ ንቅናቄ በተባለ የተቃዋሚ ቡድን አስተባባሪነት የተሰባሰቡ ሲሆን፣ በሀገሪቱ የኤሌክትሪክ መቆራረጥ እና እየጨመረ የመጣውን የኑሮ ውድነት ተቃውመዋል። ይህ ድርጊት መንግስት በአሁኑ ወቅት እየተጋፈጠ ካለው የኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ ጋር በተያያዘ በህዝቡ ዘንድ ያለውን ቅር መሰኘት ያሳያል።
oromo: Tuniziyaatti namoonni dhibbaan lakkaa'aman magaala guddoo biyyattii keessatti hiriira ba'uun, pirezidaanti Kaayis Sa'iid aangoo gadhiisuu akka qaban gaafataniiru. Hiriirichi kan qindaa'e garee mormituu haaraa 'Nafas Movement' jedhamuun yoo ta'u, sababni isaas rakkoo hir'ina humna ibsaa fi gatii jireenyaa dabaluu mormuufi. Hiriirri kun mootummaan amma jiru rakkoo diinagdee biyyattii furuu irratti dadhabuun isaa ummata biratti mufannaa guddaa uumuu isaa agarsiisa.

title: Can a humanitarian disaster be averted in Somalia?
english: Somalia is facing a severe hunger crisis that threatens approximately six million people due to persistent drought, ongoing conflict, and displacement. Efforts to provide essential relief are currently hindered by decades of instability and a significant reduction in international funding. Aid organizations are struggling to operate, leaving the nation at a critical juncture where the risk of starvation continues to rise.
amharic: ሶማሊያ በድርቅ፣ በግጭት እና በስደት ምክንያት ስድስት ሚሊዮን የሚጠጉ ዜጎቿ ለከፍተኛ የረሃብ አደጋ ተጋልጠዋል። ለረጅም ዓመታት በቆየው አለመረጋጋት እና በአለም አቀፍ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ እጥረት ምክንያት የሰብአዊ እርዳታ አቅርቦት በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ተስተጓጉሏል። በዚህም የተነሳ እርዳታ ሰጪ ድርጅቶች በቂ ድጋፍ ለማድረግ እየተቸገሩ በመሆኑ ሀገሪቱ ለከፋ የረሃብ አደጋ ተጋልጣለች።
oromo: Somaliyaan sababa gogiinsa, walitti buiinsa fi buqqaatii ummataa irra gaheen namoota miiliyoona jahaan ol ta'an rakkina beelaa hamaaf saaxilamtee jirti. Tasgabbii dhabuun biyyattii fi gargaarsi idil-addunyaa hir'achuun isaa tattaaffii gargaarsa namoomaa irratti gufuu guddaa ta'eera. Dhaabbileen gargaarsaatis baajata gahaa dhabuun isaanii fi haala jiruun kan ka'e, balaan beelaa biyyattii keessatti daran hammaachaa dhufeera.

title: Pope Leo urges the world to ‘help begin reconstruction’ of Gaza
english: Pope Leo XIV has called on global leaders to provide urgent assistance to the people of Gaza. He highlighted that the residents are facing severe hardship and emphasized the need for immediate efforts to rebuild the region. The appeal aims to rally international support to alleviate the ongoing humanitarian crisis.
amharic: ርዕሰ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳት ሊዮ አሥራ አራተኛ በጋዛ የሚገኙ ሰዎች ከፍተኛ ችግር ውስጥ መሆናቸውን በመግለጽ ዓለም አቀፍ መሪዎች በአካባቢው የመልሶ ግንባታ ስራ እንዲጀምሩ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። የጋዛ ነዋሪዎች እየደረሰባቸው ያለውን ሰብአዊ ቀውስ ለመቅረፍ ፈጣን ድጋፍ እንደሚያስፈልግ አስገንዝበዋል። ይህ ጥሪ ዓለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብ ለችግረኞች እንዲደርስ ለማነሳሳት ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Paphaasii Liyoo 14ffaan hoggantoota addunyaa maraaf waamicha dhiyeessuun, namoota Gaazaatti rakkatanii jiraniif gargaarsa ariifachiisaa akka taasisan gaafataniiru. Namoonni kun miidhaa hamaa keessa akka jiran eeruun, naannichatti hojiilee ijaarsa irra deebii jalqabuun barbaachisaa ta'uu ibsaniiru. Waamichi kun rakkoo namoomaa yeroodhaa gara yerootti hammaataa jiru kana furuuf gargaarsa idil-addunyaa walitti qabuuf kan karoorfame dha.

title: Bolivia’s President Rodrigo Paz fires economy minister amid unrest
english: Bolivian President Rodrigo Paz has dismissed his economy minister, Jose Gabriel Espinoza, following a legislative censure. This decision follows growing public frustration over the country’s severe economic crisis and rising poverty rates. Oscar Mario Justiniano Pinto has been appointed as the interim replacement while the government attempts to stabilize the nation's struggling financial situation.
amharic: የቦሊቪያው ፕሬዝዳንት ሮድሪጎ ፓዝ፣ በፓርላማ ከተወገዙ በኋላ የኢኮኖሚ ሚኒስትራቸውን ሆሴ ገብርኤል እስፒኖዛን ከሥራ አሰናብተዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ በሀገሪቱ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የኑሮ ውድነት እና የኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ ተከትሎ በሕዝብ ዘንድ የነበረውን ተቃውሞ ለማርገብ የተወሰደ እርምጃ ተደርጎ ተወስዷል። እስካሁን ድረስ ኦስካር ማሪዮ ጁስቲኒያኖ ፒንቶ በጊዜያዊነት ቦታውን እንዲይዙ ተደርጓል።
oromo: Pirezedaantiin Boliiviyaa Roodriigoo Paaz, ministira diinagdee isaanii Jooze Gaabireel Espinoozaa erga mana maree biyyattii irraa komatamee booda aangoo irraa kaaseera. Murtiin kun rakkoo diinagdee cimaa biyyattii keessatti mudateefi hiyyummaa dabaluu irratti mormii uummata ka'e tasgabbeessuuf kan fudhatame dha. Oskaar Maariyoo Juustiniyaanoo Piintoon hanga bakka buutuun dhaabbataa argamutti ministira diinagdee ta'anii akka tajaajilan ramadamaniiru.

title: Western allies slam Israel for ending World Central Kitchen strike probe
english: The United Kingdom, Australia, and Canada have condemned Israel's decision to forgo a criminal investigation into the 2024 drone strike that killed seven World Central Kitchen aid workers in Gaza. These nations, alongside Poland, expressed deep disappointment and are demanding accountability for the tragedy, which Israel previously labeled a mistake. The international community continues to pressure Israel to fulfill its obligations under humanitarian law and provide justice for the families of the victims.
amharic: የእንግሊዝ፣ የአውስትራሊያ እና የካናዳ መንግስታት በእስራኤል የጦር ሃይል በ2024 የዓለም ማዕከላዊ ኩሽና (World Central Kitchen) የሰብአዊ እርዳታ ሰራተኞች ላይ የተፈጸመውን ጥቃት የወንጀል ምርመራ ላለማድረግ መወሰኗን አውግዘዋል። እነዚህ ሀገራት ከፖላንድ ጋር በመሆን ውሳኔውን አሳፋሪ ሲሉ የገለጹት ሲሆን፣ እስራኤል ለተጎጂዎች ቤተሰቦች ፍትህን እንድታሰፍን እና አለም አቀፍ የሰብአዊ ህግን እንድታከብር ጠይቀዋል። እስራኤል ጥቃቱን 'አሳዛኝ ስህተት' ብትለውም፣ ዓለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብ ግን ለተጠያቂነት መረጋገጥ ግፊት ማድረጉን ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Mootummoonni UK, Ostiraaliyaa fi Kanaadaa, Israa'el bara 2024 ogeeyyii gargaarsaa garee 'World Central Kitchen' torba galaafate irratti qorannoo yakkaa hin gaggeessinu jechuun ishii baay'ee mormaniiru. Biyyoonni kunniin fi biyyi Poolaand murtee kana 'qaanii' jechuun ibsaniru; Israa'el haqa akka mirkaneessitu fi seera namoomaa idil-addunyaa akka kabajju gaafataniiru. Israa'el haleellaa kana 'dogoggora gaddisiisaa' jedhee ibsuu ishii iyyuu, hawaasni idil-addunyaa itti-gaafatamummaan akka jiraatu dhiibbaa gochuu itti fufuufi.

title: US Supreme Court allows Trump’s ballroom project to continue for now
english: The U.S. Supreme Court has issued a temporary order allowing President Donald Trump to continue construction on a $400 million White House ballroom project. This decision pauses a lower court ruling that had halted the development due to a lack of congressional approval. Chief Justice John Roberts granted the stay while the Supreme Court reviews the administration's emergency appeal, which claims the construction is a matter of national security.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በዋይት ሀውስ ውስጥ እያከናወኑት ያለውን የ400 ሚሊዮን ዶላር የመዝናኛ አዳራሽ ግንባታ ለጊዜው እንዲቀጥል ፈቅዷል። ይህ ውሳኔ የኮንግረስ ፈቃድ አላገኘም በሚል ግንባታውን ለማቆም የታዘዘውን የታችኛው ፍርድ ቤት ትዕዛዝ አግዶታል። ዋና ዳኛ ጆን ሮበርትስ አስተዳደሩ ያቀረበውን ይግባኝ ፍርድ ቤቱ እስኪመረምር ድረስ ግንባታው እንዲቀጥል የፈቀዱ ሲሆን፣ መንግስት ግንባታው ለሀገር ደህንነት አስፈላጊ መሆኑን በመከራከር ላይ ይገኛል።
oromo: Mana murtii olaanaa Amerikaa, pirezidaant Donaald Traamp mana qophee waayit haawsii irratti ijaarsa doolaara miiliyoona 400 baasuuf karoorfatan hojiirra oolchuuf hayyama kenneera. Murni kun kan murtaa'e, ijaarsi kun hayyama koongeerasiin ala waan ta'eef akka dhaabbatu mana murtii gadii irraa ajajni kenname ture akka ittisuufi. Jijjirri kun kan ta'e, bulchiinsi Traamp ijaarsi kun nageenya biyyaaf barbaachisaa dha jedhee waan falmateef, murtii dhumaa yeroo argatuuf ragaa haala yeroo eeggatee ture.

title: Trump waives ‘out-of-quota’ beef tariffs for 90 days to lower prices
english: President Donald Trump has announced a 90-day suspension of beef tariffs to allow for the duty-free import of 300,000 tonnes of ground beef. This initiative aims to reduce grocery costs for Americans by securing foreign meat at prices 25 percent lower than current market rates. While the specific countries or suppliers involved remain undisclosed, the administration intends to use this measure to combat inflation and support the recovery of the domestic cattle industry.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የከብት ሥጋ ዋጋን ለመቀነስ ሲባል ለ90 ቀናት የሚቆይ የታሪፍ እገዳ ማወጃቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ 300,000 ቶን የተፈጨ የከብት ሥጋ ከቀረጥ ነጻ ወደ አሜሪካ እንዲገባ የሚፈቅድ ሲሆን፣ የውጭ አቅራቢዎችም ምርቱን ካለው የገበያ ዋጋ በ25 በመቶ ቅናሽ እንዲሸጡ ስምምነት ተደርሷል። ምንም እንኳን ስምምነቱ ከየትኞቹ አገራት ጋር እንደተደረገ ይፋ ባይሆንም፣ አስተዳደሩ ይህ እርምጃ በዋጋ ግሽበት የተጎዱ አሜሪካውያንን ለመርዳት እና የሀገር ውስጥ የከብት እርባታን ለማነቃቃት ያለመ መሆኑን ገልጿል።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Doolaard Traamp gatii foon qonnaan bulaa hir'isuuf jecha gibira fooniirra jiru guyyoota 90f akka dhaabamu labsaniiru. Tarkaanfii kanaan toonii 300,000 kan ta'u foon qonnaan bulaa gibira malee gara Ameerikaatti akka galu kan heyyamamu yoo ta'u, alagootnis gatii gabaa ammee keessaa dhibbeentaa 25 gadi buusuun akka gurguran waliigalteen taasifameera. Waliigalteen kun biyyoota kam waliin akka ta'e ifa baafamuu baatus, mootummaan tarkaanfichi gatii hammaataa jiru hir'isuufi horsiisa loonii biyyattii deebisanii cimsuuf kan gargaaru ta'uu ibseera.

title: US court slashes Alex Jones fines for Sandy Hook school shooting case
english: A Texas appeals court has significantly reduced the damages owed by conspiracy theorist Alex Jones from $50 million to $1.5 million regarding his false claims about the Sandy Hook school shooting. The court determined that the evidence provided by the victims' parents did not meet the state's legal requirements for higher punitive damages. Despite this reduction, Jones remains liable for over a billion dollars in other separate legal judgments related to the same case.
amharic: የቴክሳስ ይግባኝ ሰሚ ፍርድ ቤት ሴራዎችን የሚያሰራጨው አሌክስ ጆንስ በሳንዲ ሁክ ትምህርት ቤት የተኩስ አደጋ ላይ የፈጠራ ወሬዎችን በማሰራጨቱ እንዲከፍል የተወሰነበትን የ50 ሚሊዮን ዶላር ካሳ ወደ 1.5 ሚሊዮን ዶላር ዝቅ አድርጎታል። ፍርድ ቤቱ ተጎጂዎቹ ወላጆች ያቀረቡት ማስረጃ በክልሉ ህግ መሰረት ከፍተኛ የቅጣት ካሳ ለማግኘት በቂ ሆኖ አላገኘውም። ይህ ውሳኔ ቢኖርም፣ ጆንስ ከዚሁ ጉዳይ ጋር በተያያዘ በሌሎች ፍርድ ቤቶች በተላለፈበት ከአንድ ቢሊዮን ዶላር በላይ የሚቆጠር የካሳ ክፍያ ግዴታው እንደቀጠለ ነው።
oromo: Mana murtii ol'aanaa Teeksas namni oduu sobaa afarsu Aleks Joonis dhukaasa manneen barnootaa Saandii Huuk ilaalchisee kaffaltii miidhaa kaffaluu qabu kanaan dura miiliyoona 50 ture gara miiliyoona 1.5 tti gadi hir'iseera. Mana murtiichatti akka himetti, ragaan warri miidhamtootaa dhiyeessan seera naannichaa kan gaaffii kaffaltii gurguddaa guutuu hin dandeenye dha. Hir'inni kun ta'uyyuu, Joonis guddina kaffaltii biroo kan miiliyoona kan lakkaa'amu kaffaluuf dirqama qabaachuu isaa itti fufa.

title: Libya rivals test a new path towards unity, 15 years after Gadaffi downfall
english: Fifteen years after the fall of Muammar Gaddafi, Libya's opposing political factions are beginning to cooperate for the first time in over a decade. The rival governments recently reached a significant agreement to share a massive national budget, signaling a shift toward stability. While the country has endured years of conflict and fractured leadership since 2011, this financial collaboration offers a potential path toward reunifying state institutions.
amharic: ሙአመር ጋዳፊ ከስልጣን ከተወገዱ አስራ አምስት አመታት በኋላ፣ የሊቢያ ተቀናቃኝ የፖለቲካ ቡድኖች ከአስር አመታት በላይ በቆየ ልዩነት ውስጥ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ እየተባበሩ ነው። ሁለቱ ወገኖች በቅርቡ ባደረጉት ስምምነት መሰረት ከፍተኛ በጀት ለመጋራት በመስማማታቸው በአገሪቱ ላይ የተረጋጋ ለውጥ እንደሚመጣ ተስፋ ተጥሏል። ከ2011 ጀምሮ ሲካሄድ የነበረው የእርስ በርስ ግጭት እና የአስተዳደር መከፋፈል አሁን እየታየ ባለው የገንዘብ ትብብር ወደ መፍትሄ ሊያመራ እንደሚችል ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Mu’amar Gadaafii erga aangoo irraa bu’anii waggoonni kudhan shaniin lakkaa’amaniiru; yeroo jalqabaatiifis gareewwan siyaasaa biyyattii wal morkatan guddina walitti dhufeenyaa irratti argamu. Mootummoonni wal dhabanii turan kun bajata biyyoolessaa gurguddaa ta’e wal qoodachuun, biyyattii keessatti tasgabbii uumuuf tarkaanfii fudhataniiru. Bara 2011 irraa eegalee rakkoo siyaasaa fi waraana hamaa keessa kan turte Liibiyaan, qindoomina kana fayyadamuun gara tokkoommatti deebi’uuf carraa gaarii argatteetti.

title: Turkiye accuses Israel’s Netanyahu of ‘genocide’, seeks Interpol warrant
english: Turkiye has officially requested an Interpol red notice for Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu following his alleged involvement in the violent interception of the Global Sumud aid flotilla in May. Turkish authorities have accused Netanyahu and others of committing serious crimes, including genocide and torture, during the military raid on activists attempting to deliver aid to Gaza. This move is part of Ankara's broader legal effort to hold Israel accountable for its actions in the Palestinian territories.
amharic: ቱርክ በግንቦት ወር ወደ ጋዛ ዕርዳታ ሊያደርሱ በተንቀሳቀሱ አክቲቪስቶች ላይ በተፈጸመው ጥቃት ተሳትፈዋል በሚል፣ በእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ ላይ የኢንተርፖል ዓለም አቀፍ የእስር ማዘዣ እንዲወጣ ጠይቃለች። የቱርክ የፍትሕ ሚኒስቴር ኔታንያሁን በዘር ማጥፋት፣ በሰብአዊነት ላይ የሚፈጸሙ ወንጀሎች እና ስቃይ ፈጽመዋል ሲል ከሷቸዋል። ይህ እርምጃ አንካራ እስራኤል በጋዛ ለምትፈጽማቸው ድርጊቶች ተጠያቂ እንድትሆን የምታደርገው የሕግ አካሄድ አካል ነው።
oromo: Turkiin, walitti bu’iinsa doonii gargaarsa gara Gaazaatti imalaa turan irratti raawwatamee ture irratti hirmaataniiru jechuun, muummicha ministeera Israa’el Binyamin Netanyaahuu irratti ajaja hidhaa idil-addunyaa (Interpol) akka baasu gaafatteetti. Ministeerri haqaa Turkii, Netanyaahuu fi namoota biroo yakka sanyii balleessuu, yakka namoomaa fi dararama raawwataniiru jechuun himateera. Tarkaanfiin kun qondaalonni Israa’el gocha Gaazaa keessatti raawwataniif akka itti gaafatamaniif tattaaffii Turkiin seeraan gochaa jirtuudha.

title: Secret tunnel becomes museum for Syria chemical attack and siege of Ghouta
english: A hospital tunnel that served as a vital evacuation route for wounded civilians during the Ghouta siege has been transformed into a museum. This site commemorates the victims of a brutal sarin gas attack carried out by Bashar al-Assad's forces thirteen years ago. The new museum aims to preserve the memory of the suffering experienced by residents during the long civil war conflict.
amharic: በሶሪያ የእርስ በርስ ጦርነት ወቅት በጉታ በተፈጸመው ከበባ ጊዜ የቆሰሉ ሰዎችን ለማዳን ሲያገለግል የነበረ አንድ የሆስፒታል ዋሻ አሁን ወደ ሙዚየም ተቀይሯል። ይህ ቦታ ከ13 ዓመታት በፊት በባሻር አል-አሳድ ኃይሎች የተፈጸመውን ገዳይ የሳሪን ጋዝ ጥቃት ለማስታወስ ታስቦ የተዘጋጀ ነው። ሙዚየሙ በጦርነቱ ወቅት ለነዋሪዎች የደረሰውን መከራና ሰቆቃ በታሪክነት ለመጠበቅ ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Godoon hospitaalaa waraana siviilii Suuriyaa keessatti, yeroo marsaa Ghoutaa namoota miidhaman baasuuf tajaajilaa ture gara muziyeemii jijjiirameera. Bakki kun miidhaa gaazii saariinii waggaa 13 dura humni Baashaar Al-Asaad raawwatan yaadachuuf kan hundeeffame dha. Muziyeemichi, yeroo waraanaa sana namoonni godambicha keessa turan miidhaa akkamii akka keessa darban seenaa isaa eeguuf gumaacha.

title: Espanyol vs Real Madrid: La Liga – prediction, lineups, teams
english: Jose Mourinho has returned to Real Madrid for his second stint as manager, beginning his campaign with an away match against Espanyol this Saturday. The veteran coach is tasked with restoring discipline and winning major titles after a period of instability and trophy droughts at the club. Real Madrid has bolstered their squad with significant new signings like Yan Diomande to help Mourinho effectively balance their star-studded lineup.
amharic: ጆዜ ሞሪንሆ ለሁለተኛ ጊዜ የሪያል ማድሪድ አሰልጣኝ በመሆን ወደ ስራቸው የተመለሱ ሲሆን፣ በመጪው ቅዳሜ በኤስፓንዮል ሜዳ የመጀመሪያ ጨዋታቸውን ያደርጋሉ። ልምድ ያለው አሰልጣኝ በክለቡ የነበረውን አለመረጋጋት በማስወገድ እና የተጫዋቾችን ዲሲፕሊን በመመለስ ዋንጫዎችን ለማስገኘት ተልዕኮ ተሰጥቷቸዋል። ሪያል ማድሪድም ይህንን አላማ ለማሳካት ያን ዲዮማንዴን የመሳሰሉ አዳዲስ ኮከብ ተጫዋቾችን ወደ ቡድኑ ቀላቅሏል።
oromo: Jose Mourinho yeroo lammaffaatiif leenjisaa Real Madrid ta'uun hojii isaa kan jalqabe yoo ta'u, tapha isaa jalqabaa Sanbata dhufu mooraa Espanyol irratti taphata. Leenjisichi muuxannoo qabu kun, rakkoo fi hanqina darbe erga sirreessee booda, gareen kun shaampiyoonaa akka ta'uuf itti gaafatamummaa fudhateera. Real Madridis karoora kana milkeessuuf akka Yan Diomande jiran taphattoota sadarkaa olaanaa qaban gabaa dabarseera.

title: Drone strike on Ukraine shopping centre kills 14, over 100 injured
english: A Russian drone attack targeted a shopping center in the Ukrainian city of Kryvyi Rih, resulting in 14 deaths and over 100 injuries. The assault involved two separate waves, with the second explosion occurring while rescue workers were actively helping victims from the first hit. Among those hurt in the tragedy were 22 children.
amharic: የሩሲያ ድሮን ጥቃት በዩክሬኗ ክሪቪ ሪህ ከተማ በሚገኝ የገበያ ማዕከል ላይ ጉዳት በማድረሱ 14 ሰዎች ሲሞቱ ከ100 በላይ የሚሆኑት ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። ጥቃቱ በሁለት ዙር የተፈጸመ ሲሆን፣ ሁለተኛው ጥቃት የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች የመጀመሪያውን ጥቃት ተከትሎ የነፍስ አድን ስራ ላይ በነበሩበት ወቅት የተፈጸመ ነው። ከተጎጂዎቹ መካከል 22 ህጻናት ይገኙበታል።
oromo: Humni Ruusiyaas dronii fayyadamun magaalaa Yukreen, Kirivii Rih keessatti bakka gabaa tokko irratti haleellaa raawwataniin lubbuun namoota 14 darbeera, namoonni 100 ol immoo miidhamaniiru. Haleellaan kun walitti aansuun yeroo lama kan raawwatame yoo ta'u, haleellaan lammaffaan yeroo gargaartonni ariifachiisaa miidhamtoota gargaaraa turanitti kan raawwatamedha. Miidhamtoota kanneen keessaa ijoolleen 22 ni argamu.

title: Russian double-tap drone strike kills 14 in Ukrainian mall, officials say
english: A Russian double-tap drone attack on a shopping center in Kryvyi Rih has resulted in at least 14 deaths and over 120 injuries. The incident involved two successive strikes, with the second one intentionally targeting emergency responders working at the site. Rescue operations are currently underway as authorities search for victims still buried under the building's debris.
amharic: በክሪቪ ሪህ ከተማ በሚገኝ የገበያ ማዕከል ላይ በተፈጸመ የሩሲያ ድርብ ድሮን ጥቃት ቢያንስ 14 ሰዎች ሲሞቱ ከ120 በላይ የሚሆኑት ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። ጥቃቱ በሁለት ዙር የተፈጸመ ሲሆን፣ ሁለተኛው ድብደባ በአደጋው ቦታ የነበሩ የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞችን ኢላማ ያደረገ ነበር። በአሁኑ ወቅት የፍርስራሹን ክምር በማንሳት በውስጥ ተጠልፈው የሚገኙ ሰዎችን ለመታደግ ሰፊ የነፍስ አድን ስራ እየተከናወነ ነው።
oromo: Humni Raashiyaa magaalaa Kirivii Rihitti bakka gabaa tokko irratti xiyyaara maleeyliin (drone) yeroo lama walitti aansuun miidhaa geessiseefiin lubbuun namoota 14 yoo darbu, namoonni 120 ol ta'an miidhamaniiru. Miidhaan kun kan raawwatame yeroo lama yoo ta'u, rukuttaa lammaffaan immoo gargaarsa ariifachiisaa kennuuf kan turan ogeessota fayyaa irratti xiyyeeffate ture. Yeroo ammaa kana namoota diigama jala jiran baasuuf hojiin barbaachaafi oolchuu cimsee itti fufee jira.

title: UK, Canada and Australia condemn Israel for refusing criminal probe into aid worker killings in Gaza
english: The governments of the UK, Canada, and Australia have expressed strong disapproval of Israel's choice not to conduct a criminal investigation into the 2024 airstrikes that killed seven World Central Kitchen aid workers in Gaza. These nations argue that the families of the victims deserve justice and that Israel has failed to ensure accountability for the loss of these humanitarian lives. Israel has maintained that its military actions did not involve criminal intent, but the three countries have urged them to fulfill their international obligations and better protect aid staff.
amharic: የእንግሊዝ፣ የካናዳ እና የአውስትራሊያ መንግስታት በ2024 በጋዛ ሰባት የዓለም ማዕከላዊ ኩሽና (WCK) የሰብአዊ እርዳታ ሰራተኞችን ለገደለው የአየር ጥቃት እስራኤል የወንጀል ምርመራ ላለማድረግ የወሰደችውን ውሳኔ በፅኑ አውግዘዋል። እነዚህ ሀገራት የተጎጂዎች ቤተሰቦች ፍትህ ሊያገኙ እንደሚገባ እና እስራኤል ለሰብአዊ ሰራተኞች ህልፈት ተጠያቂነትን በማረጋገጥ ረገድ መክሸፏን ገልጸዋል። እስራኤል ወታደራዊ እርምጃዋ የወንጀል ዓላማ አልነበረውም ብትልም፣ ሶስቱ ሀገራት እስራኤል በዓለም አቀፍ ህግ መሰረት ግዴታዋን እንድትወጣ እና የእርዳታ ሰራተኞችን ደህንነት እንድታረጋግጥ ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Mootummoonni UK, Kaanaadaa fi Awustiraaliyaa, bara 2024 Gaazaatti hojjettoota gargaarsa namoomaa torba World Central Kitchen ajjeese irratti Israa'el qorannoo yakkaa banuu diduun ishee mormanii jiru. Biyyoonni kun maatiin miidhamtootaa haqaa argachuu akka qaban fi Israa'el gargaartota kana du'a irraa oolchuu fi gaaffii irratti gaafatamuu dhabuu ishee balaaleeffatanii jiru. Israa'el tarkaanfiin waraanaa ishee yakka kan hin of-keessatti hammanne ta'uu ibsituus, biyyoonni kunneen Israa'el dirqama seera idil-addunyaa akka kabajjuu fi hojjettoota gargaarsaa akka eegdu gaafatanii jiru.

title: Two injured in stabbing attack at Canada Sikh temple
english: Two people were injured during a stabbing attack at a Sikh temple in Edmonton, Canada, early Friday morning. Police have taken a suspect into custody, though they have not yet disclosed a motive for the violence. The incident has raised concerns about increasing hostility toward the Sikh community in the region.
amharic: አርብ ማለዳ በካናዳ ኤድመንተን ከተማ በሚገኝ የሲክ እምነት ተከታዮች ቤተመቅደስ ውስጥ በደረሰ የቢላዋ ጥቃት ሁለት ሰዎች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ፖሊስ ጥርጣሬ ያደረበትን ግለሰብ በቁጥጥር ስር ያዋለ ቢሆንም፣ የጥቃቱ አላማ ግን እስካሁን አልታወቀም። ይህ ክስተት በክልሉ ውስጥ በሲክ ማህበረሰብ ላይ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የጥላቻ ድርጊት አስመልክቶ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Guyyaa Jimaata ganama biyya Kanadaa magaalaa Edmantonitti, manneen sagadaa amantii Siikii keessatti namoota lama irratti rukuttaa billawaa geessifameera. Poolisiin shakkamaa tokko to’annoo jala oolcheera; ta’us sababa ajjeechaa kanaa hanga ammaatti ifa hin taane. Miidhaan kun naannichatti hawaasa Siikii irratti jibbiinsii fi miidhaan dabalaa dhufuu isaa yaaddoo uumeera.

title: Former Pakistan PM Imran Khan taken back to prison after hospital check-up
english: Former Pakistani Prime Minister Imran Khan was sent back to Adiala Jail following a brief medical evaluation mandated by the court. His family claims that the politician is being subjected to torture while in custody. The move follows his recent hospital visit, which took place amid ongoing concerns regarding his treatment behind bars.

Maatiin isaanii akka jedhanitti, yeroo hidhaa jiran kana keessatti dararaa irra gahaa jiraachuu dubbatu. Tarkaanfiin kunis haala itti hidhamanii jiran irratti yaaddoo guddaan uumamee jiruun booda kan fudhatameedha.

title: Russian drone attack on busy shopping centre kills 14 in Ukraine
english: A Russian drone strike on a crowded shopping center in the Ukrainian city of Kryvyi Rih has resulted in the deaths of 14 people and left over 120 others injured. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy condemned the assault as a deliberate act of terror, noting that a second strike targeted rescue workers. This incident occurred alongside a separate deadly attack in the Mykolaiv region, highlighting the ongoing civilian danger in the conflict.

oromo: Magalaa Kriyvii Rih kan Yuukreenitti, haleellaa xiyyaara raadaaraa (drone) Ruusiyaan bakka waldaa gurgurtaa namoonni baay'een jiranitti raawwatteetin lubbuun namoota 14 darbeera; namoonni 120 ol ta'anis madaa'aniiru. Prezidaant Volodimiir Zeelenskiin haleellaa kana gocha shororkeessummaa kan jedhan yoo ta'u, haleellaan lammaffaan fayyistoota balaa irratti kan xiyyeeffate ta'uu ibsaniiru. Gochi kun haleellaa naannoo Miykolaayivitti raawwatamee fi lubbuu namoota hedduu galaafate wajjin wal qabatee, nageenyi ummata nagaa waraana kana keessatti sadarkaa sodaachisaa irra akka jiru agarsiisa.

title: How is drought hitting UK farming?
english: England is currently facing a severe drought affecting two-thirds of the country following an extended period of intense heat and lack of rain. This weather crisis is significantly impacting British farmers and their productivity. Consequently, agricultural workers are now being compelled to change their farming methods to better cope with the ongoing climate shift.

Haala kana irraa kan ka'e, qonnaan bultoonni jijjiirama qilleensaa kanaan wal-qabatee mala qonnaa isaanii haaromsuuf dirqamaa jiru.

title: Israeli forces kill Palestinian man in Gaza
english: Israeli forces killed a 29-year-old Palestinian man named Ibrahim Mohammed Kawar’a in the southern Gaza Strip on Friday. Reports indicate that the victim had been restrained with handcuffs and shackles prior to the shooting. His body was subsequently transported to a medical facility in Khan Younis.

title: Iran president says time to end war while in position of strength
english: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has called for an immediate conclusion to the ongoing conflict with the United States. He believes Tehran is currently in a strong, favorable position and urged for negotiations while maintaining this perceived power. Pezeshkian also strongly criticized the U.S. military actions, accusing them of targeting civilian infrastructure and violating international standards.

Iraan amma sadarkaa cimaa fi iddoo gaarii irra waan jirtuuf, humna kana fayyadamuun marii jalqabuun akka isaanitti tolu dubbataniiru. Kana malees, Ameerikaan bu'uuraalee misoomaa fi dhaabbilee sivilii miidhuun seera idil-addunyaa cabsitee jirti jechuun komataniiru.

title: FM Araghchi says US economic pressure campaign is doomed to fail
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has dismissed President Trump’s threats of intense new economic sanctions against his country. He stated that these tactics are destined to fail, noting that similar attempts to cripple Iran's economy in the past were unsuccessful. Araghchi remains confident that Iran can withstand such pressures, characterizing the American approach as a repetitive and ineffective strategy.

Ministirichi mootummaan Iraan dhiibbaa kana dandamachuu akka danda'u ibsaniiru.

title: 'Shameful:' UK, Canada and Australia condemn Israel's refusal to investigate aid worker attack
english: The UK, Canada, and Australia have formally condemned Israel for its refusal to open a criminal investigation into a 2024 airstrike that killed seven World Central Kitchen aid workers in Gaza. These nations labeled the decision shameful and argued that the victims' families deserve accountability for the tragedy. This move highlights growing international frustration, as humanitarian workers continue to face extreme danger while operating in the conflict zone.

Biyyoonni kun murtee Israa'el kana 'kan nama qaanessu' jechuun ibsanii, maatiin miidhamtootaa haqaa argachuu akka qaban gaafataniiru. Haleellaan gargaarsa kennitoota irratti raawwatamu kun fiixee irra gahuun isaa fi Israa'el qorannoo diduun ishee, addunyaa irratti mufii guddaa uumeera.

title: Arsenal sign Konsa from Villa as Premier League holders bolster defence
english: Arsenal have completed the signing of England international defender Ezri Konsa from Aston Villa for a reported fee of £51 million. The 28-year-old has signed a long-term contract to help strengthen the Gunners' defense following William Saliba's long-term injury. Manager Mikel Arteta believes Konsa's experience and versatility will be crucial as the club aims to successfully defend their Premier League title.

title: Why Iran is threatening Europe’s ‘strategically important’ southeast
english: Iran has issued warnings against Bulgaria following its decision to allow US forces to use the Bezmer Air Base for military operations. Experts suggest Iran is targeting southeastern Europe because it serves as a critical strategic hub for NATO and supplies destined for Ukraine.
