oromo: Iraan, biyyi Bulgaariyaa buufata xiyyaraa Bezmer humnoota Ameerikaaf akka fayyadaman eeyyamuun ishee hordofee akeekkachiisa dabarsiteetti. Tehraan akka ibsitetti, biyyi kamiyyuu haleellaa Ameerikaa deggeru kamiyyuu akka kaadhimamaa haleellaa ijaan ilaalamuun isaa hin oolu. Ogeeyyonni akka jedhanitti, Iraan kibba-baha Awurooppaa kan kaayyoo godhatte, naannichi damee waraanaa NATO fi gargaarsa gara Yuukreen deemuuf bakka murteessaa waan ta'eef dha.

title: Israeli army, settlers kill 2 Palestinians in separate West Bank incidents
english: Two Palestinian men, a 17-year-old and a 58-year-old, were killed in separate violent encounters in the occupied West Bank on Friday. The teenager was shot during an attack by armed Israeli settlers in Hebron, while the older man, a retired colonel, was killed by Israeli forces during a military raid in Jenin. These incidents occur as tensions rise due to increasing military raids and settler violence in the region.
amharic: በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አካባቢ በሁለት የተለያዩ ጥቃቶች ሁለት ፍልስጤማውያን መገደላቸው ተዘግቧል። አንደኛው የ17 ዓመት ወጣት በሄብሮን በሰፈራ ነዋሪዎች ሲገደል፣ ሌላኛው የ58 ዓመት የቀድሞ የጦር መኮንን በጀኒን በእስራኤል ወታደሮች ተገድሏል። እነዚህ ግድያዎች የተፈጸሙት በአካባቢው እየጨመረ በመጣው ወታደራዊ ወረራ እና የሰፈራ ጥቃቶች መካከል ነው።
oromo: Godina waldhabdee West Baankitti guyyaa Jimaata darbe walitti buiinsa adda addaa lamaan lammiileen Palastine lama ajjeefamaniiru. Dargaggeessi umriin isaa 17 ta'e Heebroonitti qonnaan bultoota Israa'el meeshaan hidhataniin yoo ajjeefamu, namni umriin isaa 58 ta'e fi kornayloo sooramaa ture ammoo magaalaa Jeniin keessatti loltoota Israa'eliin ajjeefame. Gochawwan kunneen kan raawwataman waraanni Israa'el bakkeewwan kunneen keessatti weerara gaggeessaa fi waldhabdeen dabalaa dhufuu hordofee dha.

title: Turkey to seek Interpol notice for Netanyahu in Gaza flotilla case
english: The Turkish government has requested an Interpol red notice to arrest Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu regarding the 2024 attack on an aid flotilla heading to Gaza. Turkish officials issued these domestic arrest warrants citing serious charges including genocide, torture, and crimes against humanity. This legal move is part of a broader case against 35 individuals involved in the interception of humanitarian vessels in international waters.
amharic: የቱርክ መንግስት ወደ ጋዛ የሰብአዊ እርዳታ ይዘው በሚጓዙ መርከቦች ላይ የተፈጸመውን ጥቃት ተከትሎ የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቢንያም ኔታንያሁ እንዲታሰሩ ኢንተርፖል ቀይ የትዕዛዝ ማውጫ እንዲያወጣ ጠይቋል። የቱርክ የፍትህ ሚኒስቴር በኔታንያሁ ላይ የዘር ማጥፋት፣ የሰብአዊነት መብት ጥሰት እና የማሰቃየት ክሶችን በመመስረት የእስር ትዕዛዝ አስተላልፏል። ይህ እርምጃ በዓለም አቀፍ ውሀዎች ውስጥ በሰብአዊ እርዳታ አቅራቢዎች ላይ የተፈጸመውን ጥቃት በተመለከተ በ35 ግለሰቦች ላይ ከተከፈተው ክስ ጋር የተያያዘ ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Turkey haleellaa doonii gargaarsa namoomaa gara Gazaatti imalaa turan irratti raawwatame ilaalchisee, ajaja qabuu (Red Notice) Interpooliin akka baasu gaafateera. Ministirri Haqaa Turkey, muummee ministiraa Israa'el Binyamin Netanyaahuun himannaa yakka sanyi-fixaansaa, dararamaa fi yakka namoomaa irratti raawwatame jedhuun himateera. Tarkaanfiin kun qorannoo namoota 35 bishaan idil-addunyaa keessatti gargaarsa namoomaa gufachiisuu irratti hirmaatan irratti gaggeeffamaa jiru keessaa kan madduudha.

title: Migrants clash with French police as they attempt to cross the Channel
english: French border officials engaged in a confrontation with a group of migrants in northern France on Friday. The incident occurred while authorities were stopping a small boat from departing toward the United Kingdom. This action is part of a broader effort by French patrols to increase the interception of unauthorized crossings across the Channel.
amharic: የፈረንሳይ ድንበር ጠባቂዎች አርብ ዕለት በሰሜናዊ ፈረንሳይ ከስደተኞች ጋር ተጋጭተዋል። ግጭቱ የተፈጠረው ባለስልጣናት ወደ እንግሊዝ ለማቅናት የሞከረች ትንሽ ጀልባን በማቆማቸው ነው። ይህ እርምጃ የፈረንሳይ የጸጥታ ኃይሎች ወደ እንግሊዝ የሚደረጉ ሕገ-ወጥ የባህር ጉዞዎችን ለመግታት እየወሰዱት ካለው ጥብቅ ቁጥጥር አንዱ አካል ነው።
oromo: Jimaata darbe, humnoonni eegumsa daangaa Faransaay fi godaantota gidduutti walitti bu'iinsi uumame. Kun kan ta'e, aangooleen biyyattii doonii xiqqoo gara biyya Ingiliz imalaa turte erga dhaabsisanii booda. Tarkaanfiin kun, humnoonni Faransaay daangaa kanatti karaa seeran alaa gara Ingiliz imaluu ittisuuf hojiiwwan jabaachaa jiran keessaa tokko dha.

title: Ukraine’s Shakhtar to use ex-Russian-owned Chelsea as Champions League home
english: Ukrainian football club Shakhtar Donetsk will host their upcoming Champions League home matches at Stamford Bridge in London. Due to the ongoing war in Ukraine, the team has been unable to play in their home country for security reasons. They selected the former home of Russian oligarch Roman Abramovich, now under American ownership, as a temporary venue for their European campaign.
amharic: የዩክሬኑ የግርግር ክለብ ሻክታር ዶኔትስክ መጪውን የቻምፒዮንስ ሊግ የሜዳ ጨዋታዎቹን በለንደን ስታምፎርድ ብሪጅ ስታዲየም ያደርጋል። በዩክሬን በሚካሄደው ጦርነት ምክንያት ክለቡ በሀገሩ ውስጥ ጨዋታዎችን ማካሄድ ባለመቻሉ ይህንን ቦታ መርጧል። ይህ ስታዲየም ቀደም ሲል በሩሲያዊው ኦሊጋርክ ሮማን አብራሞቪች ባለቤትነት ስር የነበረ ቢሆንም አሁን በአሜሪካውያን ቁጥጥር ስር ይገኛል።
oromo: Kilabni kubbaa miillaa Yukreen Shaakhtar Dooneetsk taphoota isaa kan Chaampiyoons Liigii biyya alaatti gaggeeffamu Londoniitti argamu Istaaadiyamii Staamford Birijitti akka taphatu murteesseera. Sababa waraana Yukreen keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiruun taphoota mana keessaa biyya ofii keessatti taphachuuf waan hin danda'amneef, filannoon kun dirqama ta'eera. Istaaadiyamichi kun kanaan dura kan ofii Ruusiyaa Roomaan Abraamoovichiin bulfamaa ture ta'us, amma garuu harka abbootii qabeenyaa Ameerikaa jala jira.

title: Ukraine sanctions popular Russian cartoon ‘Masha and the Bear’
english: The Ukrainian government has officially sanctioned the producers of the popular Russian animated series Masha and the Bear. Officials claim the show functions as a tool for pro-Russian propaganda and poses a risk to national security. Through this decree, Ukraine aims to stop the distribution and monetization of the cartoon, both domestically and on international streaming platforms.
amharic: የዩክሬን መንግስት ተወዳጁን የሩሲያ የህፃናት አኒሜሽን 'ማሻ እና ድቡ' አምራቾች ላይ ማዕቀብ መጣሉን ይፋ አድርጓል። ባለስልጣናቱ ፕሮግራሙ የሩሲያ ደጋፊ ፕሮፓጋንዳ እንደሚያሰራጭ እና ለሀገራዊ ደህንነት ስጋት እንደሆነ ይገልፃሉ። በዚህ አዋጅ አማካኝነት ዩክሬን የካርቱን ፕሮግራሙ በሀገር ውስጥም ሆነ በአለም አቀፍ መድረኮች እንዳይሰራጭ እና ገቢ እንዳያገኝ ለማገድ እየሰራች ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Yukreeniiloota fiilmii daa'immanii beekamaa kan ta'e 'Maashaa fi Dhabbicha' oomishaniirratti tarkaanfii sanadaa fudhateera. Qindeessitoonni fiilmichaa kun ergaa deggersa Raashiyaa babal'isaa fi nageenya biyyattii miidhuu danda'a jedhanii amanu. Tarkaanfiin kun qabiyyee fiilmichaa biyya keessatti dhoorkuufi akkasumas miidiyaalee idil-addunyaa irratti faayidaa maallaqaa akka hin arganne gochuuf kan kaayyeffateedha.

title: What to know about the Freedom 250 Grand Prix, Trump’s capital car race
english: President Donald Trump is hosting the Freedom 250 Grand Prix, a new IndyCar race taking place on the streets of Washington, D.C. as part of the nation's 250th anniversary celebrations. While the administration promotes the event as a grand display of American heritage and motorsport history, critics have raised concerns about the impact on city traffic and potential conflicts of interest involving event sponsors. This race marks a significant addition to a series of high-profile sporting events organized by the White House to commemorate the country's milestone.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የአሜሪካን 250ኛ ዓመት በዓል ምክንያት በማድረግ በዋሽንግተን ዲሲ ጎዳናዎች ላይ የሚካሄድ የኢንዲካር ውድድር እያዘጋጁ ነው። አስተዳደሩ ይህንን ውድድር የአሜሪካን ታሪክ እና የሞተር ስፖርት ክብርን የሚገልጽ ታላቅ ክስተት ብሎ ቢጠራውም፣ በከተማዋ የትራፊክ እንቅስቃሴ ላይ ስለሚኖረው ተጽዕኖ እና ስለ ስፖንሰር አድራጊዎች የተነሱ ቅሬታዎች አሉ። ይህ ውድድር በኋይት ሀውስ ለበዓሉ አከባበር ከተዘጋጁ በርካታ የስፖርት ዝግጅቶች አንዱ ነው።
oromo: Pireezidaant Donald Traamp ayyaana waggaa 250ffaa biyyattii kabajuuf jecha, magaalaa Waashingitan Disii keessatti dorgommii konkolaataa IndyCar kan qopheessani dha. Mootummaan dorgommii kana seenaa Ameerikaa fi tapha konkolaataa kan mul'isu akka ta'e ibsuus, namoonni hedduun garuu cufiinsa daandii fi gaaffiiwwan fayyadamummaa qabeenyaa waliin walqabatan kaasaniiru. Dorgommiin kun qophiilee seena-qabeessa ta'an kanneen mana maree biyyattii keessatti ayyaaneffataman keessaa isa tokko dha.

title: England thrash Pakistan by an innings and 103 runs in first Test
english: England secured a dominant victory over Pakistan in the first Test, winning by an innings and 103 runs within just three days. This match marked Joe Root’s successful return as captain, following a period of team instability. England's bowling attack was exceptional, with Josh Tongue and Ollie Robinson delivering career-best performances to dismantle the Pakistani batting lineup.
amharic: እንግሊዝ በፓኪስታን ላይ በተደረገው የመጀመሪያ የሙከራ ግጥሚያ በአንድ ኢኒንግስ እና በ103 ሩጫዎች አሳማኝ ድል ተቀዳጅታለች። ይህ ድል የጆ ሩት በአዲሱ የቡድን መሪነት ሚና የተሳካ ጅምር ሲሆን ግጥሚያውም በሶስት ቀናት ውስጥ ተጠናቋል። የእንግሊዝ የቦውሊንግ ቡድን በአስደናቂ ብቃት የፓኪስታንን ተጫዋቾች በማውጣት የላቀ ውጤት አስመዝግቧል።
oromo: Ingiliz tapha qormaata jalqabaa Paakistaan wajjin taasisteen, innings tokko fi fiigicha 103n injifachuu dandeesseetti. Injifannoon kun yeroo Joe Root hoogganaa ta'ee deebi'e kanatti kan argame yoo ta'u, taphichi guyyoota sadii qofatti xumurameera. Gareen boulingii Ingiliz dandeettii olaanaadhaan Paakistaanota tapha keessaa baasuudhaan injifannoo guddaa galmeessiseera.

title: Arsenal vs Coventry LIVE: Premier League
english: The 2026-27 Premier League season officially begins with a match between Arsenal and Coventry City. The game is being held at the Emirates Stadium in London. Kick-off is scheduled for 8:00 PM local time as the newly-promoted visitors take on the defending champions.
amharic: የ2026-27 የፕሪሚየር ሊግ የውድድር ዘመን በአርሰናል እና በኮቨንትሪ ሲቲ መካከል በሚደረገው ጨዋታ በይፋ ተጀምሯል። ጨዋታው የሚካሄደው በለንደን በሚገኘው ኤምሬትስ ስታዲየም ነው። አዲስ ወደ ሊጉ ያደገው ኮቨንትሪ ሲቲ ከሻምፒዮኑ አርሰናል ጋር የሚያደርገው ጨዋታ በኢትዮጵያ አቆጣጠር ማታ 8:00 ሰዓት ይጀምራል።
oromo: Barri tapha Priimer Liigii 2026-27 tapha Arsenaal fi Koventirii Siitii gidduutti godhamuun seeraan jalqabameera. Taphi kunis kan gaggeeffamu buufata Arsenaal kan ta'e Emireets Istadiyeemitti dha. Gareen haaraa Priimer Liigiitti makame Koventirii Siitiin, injifataa liiigichaa Arsenaal wajjin taphachuu kan jalqaban sa'aatii 8:00 galgala irratti.

title: Israeli settlers set fire to heavy machinery at West Bank quarry
english: Israeli settlers broke into a quarry located near Hebron in the West Bank overnight and deliberately set fire to heavy construction equipment. Palestinian workers discovered the extensive damage to their machinery the following morning. Local police are currently investigating the incident, which included the discovery of graffiti left by the perpetrators at the scene.
amharic: የእስራኤል ሰፈራ ነዋሪዎች በምዕራብ ባንክ ሄብሮን አቅራቢያ በሚገኝ ድንጋይ መፈልፈያ ቦታ ገብተው ከባድ የሥራ መኪኖችን በእሳት አቃጥለዋል። የፍልስጤም ሠራተኞች ጠዋት ላይ ማሽኖቻቸው ላይ የደረሰውን ጉዳት የተመለከቱ ሲሆን፣ በአካባቢው የተገኙ ምስሎች እና ጽሑፎች ወንጀሉ በእነሱ መፈጸሙን ያሳያሉ። ፖሊስ በአሁኑ ወቅት ጉዳዩን በመመርመር ላይ ይገኛል።
oromo: Buqqaattoonni Israa'el halkan keessa lafa gaaraa Heebroonitti argamu tokko keessa seenuudee maashinoota hojii ijaarsaa gurguddoo gubaniiru. Hojjettoonni Falasxiin ganama ka’anii gaaga’ama maashinoota isaanii irratti ga’e arganiiru. Poolisiin naannichaa dhimmicha irratti qorannoo eegaleera, bakka sanattis mallattoolee gubaa fi barreeffamoota yakka kana agarsiisan argateera.

title: Jannik Sinner to miss US Open tennis major due to knee injury
english: Top-ranked tennis star Jannik Sinner has officially withdrawn from the upcoming US Open due to a persistent right knee injury. Despite working closely with his medical team to recover, the 25-year-old athlete confirmed he is not fit to compete in the tournament. This marks the first time Sinner will miss a Grand Slam event since his professional debut in 2019.
amharic: የዓለማችን ቁጥር አንድ የቴኒስ ኮከብ ጃኒክ ሲነር በቀኝ ጉልበቱ ላይ በደረሰበት ጉዳት ምክንያት በሚመጣው የዩኤስ ኦፕን ውድድር ላይ እንደማይሳተፍ አስታውቋል። አትሌቱ ከህክምና ቡድኑ ጋር በመሆን ጉዳቱን ለማከም ጥረት ቢያደርግም፣ ለውድድሩ በቂ ዝግጅት ማድረግ ባለመቻሉ መቅረቱን አረጋግጧል። ይህ በ2019 ወደ ግራንድ ስላም ውድድሮች ከተቀላቀለ ወዲህ ሲነር በውድድሩ ሲያመልጠው የመጀመሪያው ነው።
oromo: Taphattoon tenisii addunyaa sadarkaa tokkoffaa irra jiru Jannik Sinner, miidhaa jilba mirgaa irra ga'een kan ka'e dorgommii US Open dhufu irratti akka hin hirmaanne beeksiseera. Atileetichi umuriin isaa 25 ta'e, garee fayyaa isaa waliin ta'ee fayyuuf yaalii godhaas, dorgommichaaf qophii gahaa gochuu waan hin dandeenyeef akka hafu mirkaneesseera. Kunis, Sinner bara 2019 dorgommiiwwan Grand Slam jalqabee kaasee dorgommii kana yeroo inni dhabu kan jalqabaati.

title: Iran, Oman discuss resuming talks, Strait of Hormuz navigation
english: The foreign ministers of Iran and Oman recently held a phone conversation to explore pathways for restarting formal negotiations between their nations. During the discussion, they also addressed ongoing concerns regarding the safety and movement of ships through the Strait of Hormuz. Both parties are working to establish a stable environment that supports future diplomatic engagement.
amharic: የኢራን እና የኦማን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሮች በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል የተቋረጠውን ድርድር እንደገና ለመጀመር የሚያስችሉ ሁኔታዎችን ለመፍጠር በስልክ ተወያይተዋል። በውይይታቸው ወቅት በሆርሙዝ የባህር ወሽመጥ አካባቢ ያለውን የመርከብ ጉዞ ደህንነት እና ተያያዥ ጉዳዮችን አንስተዋል። ሁለቱም ወገኖች ለቀጣይ የዲፕሎማሲ ግንኙነት ምቹ ሁኔታን ለመፍጠር እየሰሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Ministiroonni dhimma alaa Iran fi Omaan marii biyyoota lamaan gidduutti ture deebisanii jalqabuuf haala mijataa uumuu irratti bilbilan mari'ataniiru. Marii isaanii kanaan, nageenyaa fi sochii dooniiwwan handaara Hormuz keessa jiru irrattis yaada walii galaniiru. Gareen lamaanuu walitti dhufeenya diippiloomaasii gara fuulduraa cimsuuf hojjechaa jiru.

title: Middle Eastern powers condemn Israeli settlement policies, reject 'E1' West Bank plan
english: A group of major Middle Eastern and Muslim-majority nations have issued a joint statement opposing Israel's settlement activities in the West Bank. They specifically denounced the E1 construction plan, describing it as a provocative step that threatens the demographics and geography of Palestinian lands. These countries are urging an immediate end to all settlement expansion to prevent further escalation in the region.
amharic: የመካከለኛው ምስራቅ እና የእስልምና ሀገራት ቡድን በእስራኤል በዌስት ባንክ እየተካሄደ ያለውን ሰፈራ በመቃወም በጋራ መግለጫ አውጥተዋል። በተለይም የ E1 የግንባታ እቅድን በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ የተቃወሙት ሲሆን፣ ይህም የፍልስጤምን መሬት ጂኦግራፊያዊ እና ህዝባዊ ይዘት የሚቀይር አደገኛ እርምጃ ነው ብለዋል። እነዚህ ሀገራት በክልሉ ያለውን ውጥረት ለማርገብ እስራኤል የሰፈራ ስራዎቿን በአስቸኳይ እንድታቆም ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Biyyoonni gurguddoon biyyoota Giddugaleessa Bahaa fi biyyoonni Islaamaa ta'an, sochii qubsuma Israa'el kan naannoo Lixaa Baankii keessatti adeemsiftu mormuun ibsa tokko baasaniiru. Keessattuu karoora ijaarsa E1 kan morman yoo ta'u, kunis lafa Falasxiin irratti jijjiirama lafaafi lakkoofsa ummataa fiduu danda'u waan ta'eef akka yaaddoo guddaatti ilaaltaniiru. Biyyoonni kunneen naannichatti waldhabdee hammaataa dhufe dhaabsisuuf, Israa'el hojii qubsumaa hunda hatattamaan akka dhaabdu gaafataniiru.

title: 'Bloodline punishment': Iranian family faces ongoing punitive ICE detention
english: An Iranian family living in Los Angeles has been detained by U.S. immigration authorities for over 130 days without any criminal record. The family members, including a teenager, had their residency status revoked due to the political actions of a relative from nearly 50 years ago. This action has been criticized as collective punishment based on family history rather than individual wrongdoing.
amharic: ሎስ አንጀለስ የሚኖሩ አንድ የኢራን ቤተሰብ ምንም አይነት የወንጀል ታሪክ ሳይኖራቸው ከ130 ቀናት በላይ በኢሚግሬሽን እስር ላይ ይገኛሉ። ቤተሰቡ ከ50 ዓመት በፊት በአንድ ዘመዳቸው በተፈጸመ የፖለቲካ ድርጊት ምክንያት የነበራቸው የመኖሪያ ፈቃድ ተሰርዟል። ይህ እርምጃ ግለሰቦቹ በራሳቸው ጥፋት ሳይሆን በቤተሰብ የዘር ግንኙነት ምክንያት እየተቀጡ መሆኑን ያሳያል።
oromo: Maatiin lammii Iraan tokko kan Los Anjeles jiraatan, yakka tokkollee osoo hin raawwatin guyyoota 130 oliif to'annoo jala oolaniiru. Maatiin kun fi mucaan isaanii kan waggaa 16, akkaataa seeraan jiraachuu isaanii kan dhaban gamaaggama firooma isaan qaban waggaa 50 dura ture irratti hundaa'uudhani. Tarkaanfiin kun namoota yakka hin raawwanne irratti adaba maatii irratti hundaa'e fudhachuu akka ta'e ibsameera.

title: Argentina’s Parades gets 10-game ban for World Cup final scuffle with Spain
english: FIFA has handed out severe penalties to three Argentina players following a violent altercation with Spain during the World Cup final. Midfielder Leandro Paredes received a 10-game ban for his role in the scuffle, while teammates Nahuel Molina and Thiago Almada also faced suspensions and fines. Additionally, the Argentine football federation was penalized for various misconduct issues, including political gestures and fan behavior during the tournament.
amharic: ፊፋ በዓለም ዋንጫው የፍጻሜ ጨዋታ ከስፔን ጋር በተፈጠረው ግጭት ተሳትፎ የነበራቸውን ሶስት የአርጀንቲና ተጫዋቾች ላይ ከባድ ቅጣት ጥሏል። አማካዩ ሊያንድሮ ፓሬደስ በፈጸመው ድርጊት የ10 ጨዋታዎች እገዳ የተጣለበት ሲሆን፣ ናሁኤል ሞሊና እና ቲያጎ አልማዳም የቅጣት እና የገንዘብ መቀጮ ተላልፎባቸዋል። ከዚህም በላይ የአርጀንቲና እግር ኳስ ፌዴሬሽን በውድድሩ ወቅት በታዩ የፖለቲካ መልእክቶች እና የደጋፊዎች አጸያፊ ድርጊቶች ምክንያት በገንዘብ ተቀጥቷል።
oromo: FIFA taphattoota Arjentiina sadii irratti guddinaaf walitti bu'iinsa isaan ispeen wajjin qophiin yeroo xumuraa waancaa addunyaarratti geggeessaniin wal qabatee adabbii cimaa buuseera. Taphataan giddugaleessaa Leandro Paredes tapha 10 irraa dhorkame yeroo ta'u, Nahuel Molina fi Thiago Almada irrattis adabbiin taphaa fi maallaqaa darbeera. Kana malees, federeeshiniin kubbaa miillaa Arjentiinaa walitti bu'iinsa, ibsa siyaasaa fi gocha fansotaan wal qabatee adabbii maallaqaa akka kaffalu ajajameera.

title: The Eritrean Script Exposes Ethiopia’s Unity Farce
english: Ethiopia's current political climate in Tigray mirrors historical mistakes that previously led to Eritrea's independence. Although the government launched a national dialogue commission to address internal conflicts, the process lacks participation from key political groups and remains ineffective in significant parts of the Tigray region. By excluding major stakeholders from national elections and decision-making, the current administration risks alienating the region in a way that recalls the failed policies of the past.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ወቅታዊ የፖለቲካ ሁኔታ፣ በተለይም በትግራይ ክልል ያለው አካሄድ፣ ቀደም ሲል ኤርትራ ከኢትዮጵያ እንድትገነጠል ካደረጉት ታሪካዊ ስህተቶች ጋር ይመሳሰላል። መንግስት የሃገሪቱን ግጭቶች ለመፍታት ብሔራዊ የምክክር ኮሚሽን ቢያቋቁምም፣ ዋና ዋና የፖለቲካ ኃይሎች በሂደቱ ውስጥ አለመካተታቸውና በብዙ የትግራይ አካባቢዎች ምክክሩ አለመጀመሩ ለሂደቱ ስኬታማነት እንቅፋት ሆኗል። በብሔራዊ ምርጫና በውሳኔ ሰጪነት ሚናዎች ውስጥ የክልሉን ተወካዮች ማግለል፣ መንግስት ከቀድሞ ታሪክ ትምህርት ሳይወስድ እንደገና ተመሳሳይ የፖለቲካ ስህተት ውስጥ እየገባ መሆኑን ያሳያል።
oromo: Haalli siyaasaa Itoophiyaa yeroo ammaa keessatti mul'atu, keessattuu naannoo Tigraay ilaalchisee, dogoggora seenaa kanaan dura biyyattii fi Eertraan wal qabsiisee ture yaadachiisa. Mootummaan rakkoolee biyya keessaa furuuf komishinii marii biyyaalessaa kan dhaabe ta'us, gareewwan siyaasaa guguddaan marii kana irraa fagaachuu fi naannoolee Tigraay hedduu keessatti mariin kun jalqabamuu dhabuun isaa rakkoo guddaa ta'eera. Naannichi filannoo biyyaalessaa fi murtee siyaasaa keessaa guutummaatti akka qooda hin fudhanne taasifamuun isaa, mootummaan seenaa irraa barnoota fudhachuu dadhabee dogoggora kanaan duraa irra deebi'aa jiraachuu isaa agarsiisa.

title: Iraq’s solar villages show how to build an energy transition that lasts
english: In Iraq's Kurdistan region, a new solar energy initiative is transforming rural life by providing villages with reliable, around-the-clock electricity. Beyond just installing solar panels, the project focuses on training local communities to manage the equipment and supporting agricultural growth through better irrigation and cold storage. This decentralized model offers a sustainable solution to long-standing power shortages and helps families stay on their land despite the growing challenges of climate change.
amharic: በኢራቅ የኩርዲስታን ክልል የተጀመረው አዲስ የፀሐይ ኃይል ፕሮጀክት ለገጠር መንደሮች አስተማማኝ እና ቀጣይነት ያለው የኤሌክትሪክ አገልግሎት በመስጠት የህዝቡን ኑሮ እየቀየረ ነው። ይህ ተነሳሽነት የፀሐይ ፓነሎችን ከመትከል ባለፈ፣ የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ቴክኖሎጂውን እንዲጠብቁ በማሰልጠን እና በግብርና ስራዎች ላይ የተሻለ ምርታማነት እንዲኖር በማድረግ ላይ ያተኩራል። ይህም የተበታተነ የኃይል አቅርቦት ዘዴ በረጅም ጊዜ ውስጥ የኤሌክትሪክ እጥረትን በመቅረፍ የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ተፅእኖዎችን ለመቋቋም ይረዳል።

Hojii kana keessatti paanaelii aduu dhaabuu qofa osoo hin taane, ummanni naannichaa meeshaalee kana akka kunuunsan leenjisuu fi carraa qonnaa babal'isuun fayyadamummaa isaanii dabalaa jira. Adeemsi kun rakkoo hanqina ibsaa bara dheeraa furuun, miidhaa jijjiirama qilleensaa dandamachuuf ganda baadiyaa keessatti gargaarsa guddaa ta'eera.

title: Manchester City’s Maresca admits he needs time as Bournemouth visit in EPL
english: Enzo Maresca has officially taken over as Manchester City manager following Pep Guardiola's departure and is preparing for his first Premier League match against Bournemouth. The new coach acknowledges that the team is undergoing a difficult transition period due to the exit of several key players. Despite these challenges, Maresca remains committed to competing for trophies and aims to continue the club's successful legacy.
amharic: ኤንዞ ማሬስካ የፔፕ ጋርዲዮላን ቦታ በመተካት የማንችስተር ሲቲ ዋና አሰልጣኝ ሆነው ተሹመዋል፣ የመጀመሪያውን የፕሪሚየር ሊግ ጨዋታ ከቦርንማውዝ ጋር ለማድረግ እየተዘጋጁ ነው። አዲሱ አሰልጣኝ በርካታ ቁልፍ ተጫዋቾች ቡድኑን በመልቀቃቸው ምክንያት ቡድኑ አስቸጋሪ የሽግግር ወቅት ላይ እንደሚገኝ ተናግረዋል። ምንም እንኳን ፈታኝ ሁኔታዎች ቢኖሩም፣ ማሬስካ ዋንጫዎችን ለማሸነፍ እና የክለቡን ስኬታማ ታሪክ ለማስቀጠል ቁርጠኛ መሆናቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Enzo Maresca bakka Pep Guardiola bu'uun leenjisaa Manchester City ta'anii kan muudaman yoo ta'u, tapha Premier League isa duraa Bournemouth waliin taphachuuf qophaa'aa jiru. Leenjisaan haaraan kun taphattoonni ijoo baay'een gadi lakkisanii waan deemaniif, gareen sun yeroo jijjiiramaa ulfaataa keessa akka jiru ibsaniiru. Rakkoowwan kunneen jiranis, Maresca waancawwan injifachuufi seenaa milkaa'ina klabichaa itti fufsiisuuf murannoon hojjachaa jira.

title: China calls for US-Iran dialogue
english: China is urging the United States and Iran to resolve their ongoing tensions through diplomatic negotiations rather than military threats. A Chinese official stated that Washington's plan to impose unilateral sanctions lacks a legal foundation and will only worsen the situation. Beijing insists that all involved parties should act with restraint to prevent further conflict.
amharic: ቻይና በአሜሪካና በኢራን መካከል እየተባባሰ የመጣውን ውጥረት በንግግርና በዲፕሎማሲያዊ መንገድ እንዲፈቱ ጥሪ አቅርባለች። የቻይና የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ ልትጥል ያቀደችው የአንድ ወገን ማዕቀብ ህጋዊ መሰረት የሌለውና ግጭትን የሚያባብስ መሆኑን ገልጿል። ቤጂንግ ሁለቱም ወገኖች መረጋጋትን በመጠበቅ አለመግባባታቸውን በውይይት እንዲፈቱ አሳስባለች።
oromo: Chaayinaan, waldhabiinsa Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduutti uumame mariidhaan akka furamu waamicha dhiyeessiteetti. Ministirri Dhimmi Alaa Chaayinaa akka ibsetti, Ameerikaan Iraan irratti sagantaa adabbii gahuuf karoorfatte bu'uura seeraa kan hin qabne fi walitti bu'iinsa kan hammaachisu dha. Chaayinaan gama lamaanuu tasgabbii qabaatanii rakkoo isaanii mariin akka furatan gorfatteetti.

title: Anas Altikriti case raises crucial questions about Britain's alliance with the UAE
english: Anas Altikriti and his family had their long-standing bank accounts closed by HSBC without specific justification, leaving them without basic financial services. Investigations revealed that the bank relied on the World-Check database, which labeled Altikriti’s organization as linked to terrorism based on information provided by the United Arab Emirates. This case highlights concerns regarding how foreign governments can influence Western financial institutions to target political opponents and the lack of transparency in such banking decisions.
amharic: አናስ አልቲክሪቲ እና ቤተሰቦቻቸው ለረጅም ዓመታት ሲጠቀሙበት የነበረው የኤች.ኤስ.ቢ.ሲ (HSBC) የባንክ ሂሳብ ያለምንም በቂ ምክንያት እንደተዘጋባቸው ይናገራሉ። ጥናቶች እንደሚያሳዩት ባንኩ ይህንን ውሳኔ የወሰነው በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ጥቅም ላይ በሚውለው የዎርልድ-ቼክ (World-Check) መረጃ ቋት ላይ በተመሰረተ ሲሆን፣ የተባበሩት አረብ ኤምሬቶች በሰጡት መረጃ መሰረት የአልቲክሪቲ ድርጅት ከሽብርተኝነት ጋር ግንኙነት እንዳለው ተደርጎ ተፈርጇል። ይህ ጉዳይ የውጭ መንግስታት በምዕራባውያን የባንክ ተቋማት ላይ ተጽዕኖ በመፍጠር ፖለቲካዊ ተቃዋሚዎችን ለመጉዳት ያላቸውን አቅም እና በባንክ ውሳኔዎች ላይ የሚታየውን ግልጽነት ማጣት አጋልጧል።
oromo: Anas Altikritii fi maatiin isaa baankii HSBC keessa waggoota dheeraaf qaban ture kan cufame sababa quubsaa tokko malee akka ta'e dubbatama. Qorannoon akka agarsiisutti, baankichi murtoo kana kan fudhate galmee 'World-Check' jedhamu irratti hundaa'uun yoo ta'u, keessaattuu mootummaan Imireetota Arabaa Gamtoomanii (UAE) dhaabbata Anas irratti himata shororkessummaa dhiyeessuun isaati. Dhimmi kun mootummoonni biyya alaa dhaabbilee faayinaansii biyyoota dhihaa dhiibbaa gochuun mormitoota isaanii miidhuu akka danda'anii fi murtoon baankiiwwanii iftoomina kan hin qabne ta'uu isaa saaxila.

title: Several injured after sword attack at Swedish school
english: A man has been arrested following a sword attack at a high school in Fagersta, Sweden, which left several people injured. Authorities placed nearby schools on lockdown while officers secured the building, though police confirmed there is no ongoing threat to the public. Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson addressed the event, noting that an investigation is underway to determine the motive behind the violence.
amharic: በስዊድን ፋገርስታ ከተማ በሚገኝ ሁለተኛ ደረጃ ትምህርት ቤት በደረሰ የሰይፍ ጥቃት በርካታ ሰዎች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ፖሊስ ጥቃቱን የፈጸመውን ሰው በቁጥጥር ስር ያዋለ ሲሆን፣ በአካባቢው የሚገኙ ሌሎች ትምህርት ቤቶችም ለደህንነት ሲባል ተዘግተው እንዲቆዩ ተደርጓል። የስዊድን ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ኡልፍ ክሪስተርሰን ክስተቱን አስከፊ እንደሆነ ገልጸው፣ የጥቃቱ መንስኤ እየተጣራ መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Sweedan, magaala Fagersta keessatti mana barumsaa sadarkaa lammaffaatti namni tokko goraadeedhaan miidhaa geessiseen namoonni hedduun madaa'aniiru. Poolisoonni shakkamicha to'annaa jala oolchanii manni barnootaa kun fi kanneen biroon tasgabbii eeguuf akka cufaman ta'eera. Muummichi ministeeraa Sweedan Ulf Kristersson akka jedhanitti, miidhaan kun kan nama gaddisiisuufi sababni isaa ammaaf qorannoorra akka jiru ibsaniiru.

title: Ebola vaccine trial to start in DR Congo as warning issued over speed of infections
english: The Democratic Republic of the Congo is launching a clinical trial of the Ervebo vaccine to combat the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, for which no proven treatment currently exists. This initiative follows a dire warning from the World Health Organization regarding the rapid, exponential spread of the virus across a vast area of the country. With the death toll approaching 2,500, officials are rushing to provide doses to health workers and test the vaccine's effectiveness to curb the deadliest outbreak in the nation's history.
amharic: የዲሞክራቲክ ኮንጎ ሪፐብሊክ በሀገሪቱ እየተስፋፋ ለሚገኘው የኢቦላ አይነት የተሻለ መፍትሄ ለመፈለግ የክትባት ሙከራ ሊጀምር ነው። የዓለም ጤና ድርጅት ቫይረሱ በአስደንጋጭ ፍጥነት በመዛመት ላይ መሆኑን በማስታወቅ፣ እስካሁን ከ2,500 በላይ ሰዎች መሞታቸውን ገልጿል። የጤና ባለሙያዎች የ'ኤርቬቦ' ክትባትን በሙከራ ደረጃ በመጠቀም የቫይረሱን ስርጭት ለመቆጣጠር እና የሟቾችን ቁጥር ለመቀነስ ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Jamhuuriyya Dimokiraatawaa Koongoo keessatti dhibeen Ebola saffisaan waan babal'achaa jiruuf, qorannoo talaallii haarawaa jalqabuuf qophii gochaa jiru. Dhaabbanni Fayyaa Addunyaa dhibeen kun bakka bal'aa akka qabatee fi lubbuun namoota 2,500 ol darbuusaa akeekkachiiseera. Talaalliin 'Ervebo' jedhamu kun gosa Ebola kan amma dararaa jiruuf furmaata ta'uu isaa mirkaneessuuf, qorannoon kun ogeeyyota fayyaa fi namoota biroo irratti kan raawwatamu ta'a.

title: Djibouti Football Federation accused of misusing funds from FIFA
english: The Djibouti Football Federation is facing serious corruption allegations following a government audit that revealed misuse of funds, favoritism, and improper bidding processes. These financial resources, which include over $1 million annually from FIFA and additional support from Saudi Arabia, are reportedly not being used to develop the sport. Frustrated club members are now calling for leadership changes, while some officials have already resigned in protest of the organization's management.
amharic: የጅቡቲ እግር ኳስ ፌዴሬሽን ከፊፋ እና ከሳዑዲ አረቢያ የተገኘን የገንዘብ ድጋፍ በአግባቡ ባለመጠቀሙ እና በጨረታ ሂደት ላይ ተፅዕኖ በመፍጠሩ በሙስና ተጠርጥሯል። የመንግስት ኦዲት እንደሚያሳየው አመራሮቹ ለስፖርቱ እድገት መዋል የነበረበትን በጀት ለግል ጥቅምና ለወዳጅ ዘመድ አድልዎ አውለዋል። በዚህም የተነሳ የአካባቢው ክለቦች የአመራር ለውጥ እንዲደረግ እየጠየቁ ሲሆን፣ አንዳንድ የፌዴሬሽኑ አባላትም በניהጃቸው አለመስማማታቸውን በመግለፅ ስራቸውን ለቀዋል።
oromo: Federeeshiniin kubbaa miilaa Jibuutii, gargaarsa maallaqaa FIFA fi Saudii Arabiyaa irraa argamu sirnaan hojiirra oolchuufi adeemsa caalbaasii irratti hanqina uumuun shakkameera. Qorannoon mootummaan gaggeesse akka agarsiisutti, maallaqni kun guddina ispoortiif ooluu qabu haalaan gumiin jiraachuu isaa ibsameera. Haaluma kanaan, bulchiinsa federeeshinichaa irratti kan mufatan garee kubbaa miilaa tokko tokko jijjiirama geggeessitootaa gaafachaa jiru, akkasumas miseensonni federeeshinichaa tokko tokko adeemsa hojiitti mufachuun aangoo gadi lakkisaniiru.

title: UK government tells Muslims to use less water for ablutions
english: The UK’s water regulator, Ofwat, has launched an initiative to encourage more efficient water usage within diverse communities, specifically targeting Islamic ablution practices and rice-washing habits. A pilot program in Cambridge demonstrated that using a single liter of water for prayer rituals could save significant amounts of water daily, while other efforts involve celebrity chefs teaching reduced water use in cooking. However, the project has faced criticism, with detractors arguing that officials should focus on repairing leaking national infrastructure rather than advising the public on personal habits.
amharic: የዩናይትድ ኪንግደም የውሃ ተቆጣጣሪ አካል ኦፍዋት (Ofwat) በባህል እና በሃይማኖት ልማዶች ውስጥ የውሃ አጠቃቀምን ውጤታማ ለማድረግ የሚያስችል ፕሮግራም ጀምሯል። ይህ መርሃ ግብር ሙስሊሞች ለጸሎት ዝግጅት የሚያደርጉትን የውሃ አጠቃቀም እና የእስያ ማህበረሰቦች ሩዝ ሲያጥቡ የሚጠቀሙትን ውሃ ለመቀነስ ያለመ ነው። በአንዳንድ አካባቢዎች የተደረጉ ሙከራዎች ጥቂት ውሃን በመጠቀም ብዙ ውሃ መቆጠብ እንደሚቻል ያሳዩ ቢሆንም፣ ተቺዎች መንግስት በግለሰቦች ላይ ከመፍረድ ይልቅ በሀገሪቱ የውሃ መሠረተ ልማት ውስጥ የሚፈሰውን ብክነት መጠገን እንዳለበት ይከራከራሉ።
oromo: Abbaan taayitaa bishaan UK (Ofwat), hawaasni bishaan qusannoon akka fayyadamuuf sagantaa haaraa hojiirra oolchee jira. Sagantaan kun keessumaa sirna wudu’aa irratti fi hawaasni Eshiyaa ruuzii yeroo dhiqan bishaan akka qusatan kan gorsuudha. Qorannoon tokko akka agarsiisutti, wudu’aaf bishaan xiqqoo fayyadamuun guyyaatti bishaan baay’ee qusachuu danda’ama, ta’us qaamni kun rakkoo inni guddaan gorsa ummataa miti, kanneen bishaan qisaasessan ijaarsawwan bishaanii kan dhangala’an sirreessuu akka qaban komatamee jira.

title: War on Iran: The US could focus on economically isolating Iran
english: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has announced a strategic shift in how the United States is handling Iran. Instead of pursuing large-scale military attacks, the government intends to prioritize efforts to isolate the country economically. This new approach marks a significant change in the administration's policy during the ongoing regional tensions.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የገንዘብ ሚኒስትር ስኮት ቤሰንት አሜሪካ በአንጻር የምትከተለውን ስትራቴጂ መቀየሯን አስታውቀዋል። አሜሪካ በትልቅ ደረጃ የሚደረጉ ወታደራዊ ጥቃቶችን ከመፈጸም ይልቅ ኢራንን በኢኮኖሚ ማግለል ላይ ትኩረት እንደምታደርግ ተገልጿል። ይህ አካሄድ አሁን ባለው የክልሉ ውጥረት ውስጥ የአሜሪካን የውጭ ጉዳይ ፖሊሲ ለውጥ የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Ministirri Maallaqa Ameerikaa Iskoot Besenti akka ibsanitti, Ameerikaan tooftaa garaa Iran irratti qabdu jijjiiruuf murteessiteetti. Biyyi sun haleellaa waraanaa gurguddaa gaggeessuu mannaa, Iran dinagdeedhaan adda baasuuf xiyyeeffannoo kennuuf jirti. Tooftaan haaromni kun, dhiibbaa naannichaa ammaa keessatti jijjiirama siyaasaa guddaa mul'isa.

title: Several people injured in sword attack at school in Sweden
english: A suspect armed with a sword attacked and injured several individuals at a high school in the Swedish town of Fagersta. Police quickly responded to the scene and took the assailant into custody, reportedly after shooting them in the leg. Authorities have locked down nearby schools while they investigate the incident and secure the area.
amharic: በስዊድን ፋገርስታ ከተማ በሚገኝ አንድ ሁለተኛ ደረጃ ትምህርት ቤት ውስጥ ሰይፍ የታጠቀ ግለሰብ ባደረሰው ጥቃት በርካታ ሰዎች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ፖሊስ ወዲያውኑ በመድረስ ተጠርጣሪውን እግሩ ላይ በመተኮስ በቁጥጥር ስር አውሏል። ባለስልጣናት አካባቢውን ለመጠበቅ እና ምርመራ ለማድረግ በቅርበት የሚገኙ ሌሎች ትምህርት ቤቶችን እንዲዘጉ አድርገዋል።
oromo: Magalaa Fagersta kan biyya Swiidenitti argamtu keessatti namni goraadee hidhate tokko mana barumsaa sadarkaa lammaffaatti miidhaa geessiseera. Poolisoonni battala bakka san ga'uun miila isaa irratti dhukaasuun shakkamaa kana to'annaa jala oolchaniiru. Aangoonni mootummaa qorannoo geggeessuuf jecha mana barumsaa naannichaatti argaman biroo cufanii jiru.

title: Trump’s ‘economic D-Day’ claims first victim: Not Iran, but US markets
english: President Trump has threatened to impose severe economic sanctions and isolation on Iran, characterizing it as an 'economic D-Day' strategy. However, these threats and the ongoing closure of the Strait of Hormuz have negatively impacted US stock markets and energy prices rather than weakening Iran. As a result, the US is facing rising living costs and a record national debt exceeding $40 trillion, fueling growing domestic discontent with the conflict.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በኢራን ላይ ከፍተኛ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ እና ጫና እንደሚጥሉ አስታውቀዋል። ይሁን እንጂ ይህ ስጋት እና የሆርሙዝ የባህር መተላለፊያ መዘጋት ኢራንን ከመጉዳት ይልቅ በዩናይትድ ስቴትስ የገበያ እንቅስቃሴ እና የነዳጅ ዋጋ ላይ አሉታዊ ተጽዕኖ አሳድሯል። በዚህ ምክንያት አሜሪካ በከፍተኛ የኑሮ ውድነት እና ከ40 ትሪሊዮን ዶላር በላይ በሆነ የብድር ዕዳ ውስጥ በመውደቋ በሀገር ውስጥ ተቃውሞ እየገጠማት ይገኛል።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Tiraamp tarkaanfii diinagdee cimaa fi kophaa ishee baasu kan 'economic D-Day' jedhaniin Iran irratti fudhachuuf doorsisaniiru. Haa ta'u malee, doorsisni kun fi cufamuu daandii galaana Hormuz Iran miidhuu mannaa gabaa fi gatii boba'aa Ameerikaa irratti dhiibbaa hamaa geessiseera. Kanaan kan ka'es, Ameerikaan baasii jireenyaa olka'aa fi liqii biyyoolessaa tiraayiliyoona 40 ol ta'een rakkachaa waan jirtuuf, lola kana irratti mormiin biyya keessaa dabalaa dhufeera.

title: Ebola outbreak ‘growing faster, ⁠⁠wider’ as DRC death toll passes 2,500: UN
english: The United Nations reports that the Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading rapidly, with the death toll now exceeding 2,500. Control efforts are being severely hindered by ongoing local conflict, violence against medical personnel, and critical funding shortages. Officials warn that without increased international support and resources, the disease threatens to spread beyond the region's borders.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት በኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ የተከሰተው የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ በከፍተኛ ፍጥነት እየተስፋፋ መሆኑን እና የሟቾች ቁጥር ከ2,500 በላይ መድረሱን አስታውቋል። በክልሉ ያለው ግጭት፣ በጤና ባለሙያዎች ላይ የሚፈጸሙ ጥቃቶች እና የገንዘብ እጥረት የበሽታውን ስርጭት ለመግታት የሚደረገውን ጥረት እያስተጓጎሉ ይገኛል። አስፈላጊው ድጋፍ ካልተደረገ ወረርሽኙ ወደ ጎረቤት አገራት የመዛመት ስጋት እንዳለው ባለሙያዎች አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomani akka ibsetti, dhibeen vaayirasii Ibolaa biyya Koongoo keessatti saffisaan babal'achaa jiraachuu fi namoonni 2,500 ol ta'an du'uu beeksiseera. Sochiin dhibee kana to'achuuf godhamaa jiru walitti bu'iinsa naannichaa, miidhaa hojjettoota fayyaa irratti raawwatamu fi rakkoo baajataatiin gufataa jira. Dabalataan, deeggarsi idil-addunyaa yoo hin taasifamne dhibeen kun biyyoota ollaa keessattis akka babal'atu ibsameera.

title: Liverpool preview: Five key questions heading into 2026-27 season
english: Liverpool is entering the 2026-27 season with a new head coach, Andoni Iraola, who aims to restore the team's competitive edge after a disappointing fifth-place finish last year. The squad is transitioning following the departure of club legend Mohamed Salah, shifting their focus toward younger players like Victor Munoz to revitalize the attack. Additionally, the team hopes that key stars Alexander Isak and Florian Wirtz will overcome previous injuries and inconsistent form to help the club challenge for the title once again.
amharic: ሊቨርፑል አዲሱን የ2026-27 የውድድር ዘመን በዋና አሰልጣኝ አንድኒ ኢራኦላ እየጀመረ ሲሆን፣ ቡድኑ ባለፈው ዓመት ያሳየውን ደካማ አቋም በማሻሻል ወደ አሸናፊነት ለመመለስ ግብ አድርጓል። ክለቡ የረጅም ጊዜ ኮከቡን መሐመድ ሳላህን ከተሰናበተ በኋላ፣ በአጥቂ መስመሩ ላይ አዳዲስ ወጣት ተጫዋቾችን በመጠቀም ለውጥ ለማምጣት እየሞከረ ነው። በተጨማሪም እንደ አሌክሳንደር ኢሳክ እና ፍሎሪያን ዊርትዝ ያሉ ቁልፍ ተጫዋቾች ከጉዳት አገግመው ቡድኑን ለዋንጫ ውድድር እንዲያበቁት ትልቅ ተስፋ ተጥሎባቸዋል።
oromo: Liiverpuul sagantaa kubbaa miilaa bara 2026-27 kan jalqabeen leenjisaa haaraa Andonii Iraolaa waliin yoo ta'u, kaayyoon isaanii dorgommii darbe keessatti sadarkaa shanffaarratti xumuruun booda gara injifannoo fi sadarkaa duraatti deebi'uudha. Taphaticha seenaa qabeessa kan ta'e Mohamed Salah erga gadi lakkisee booda, kilabichi dargaggoota akka Victor Munoz fayyadamuun weerara isaanii haaromsachuuf yaalaa jira. Akkasumas, taphattoonni gurguddoon akka Alexander Isak fi Florian Wirtz miidhaa irra turan irraa fayyanii, kilabicha dorgommii waancaa keessatti akka cimsan abdii guddaa qabu.
